fields.AU:
The Sunny Health & Fitness Treadmill Mat is essential for protecting your floors and carpet from the wear and tear of a treadmill or exercise equipment. Made with high-density PVC foam material for greater durability and comfort. It features a soft, textured base, perfect for vibration and noise reduction. The Sunny Health & Fitness Treadmill Mat is lightweight, non-slip, water-resistant, and very easy to clean.
• DURABILITY: This heavy-duty, durable and waterproof exercise mat prolongs the life of your equipment by helping prevent floor and carpet dust from entering belts and mechanical parts.
• HEAVY-DUTY MATERIAL: Made with high-density PVC foam material for greater durability and comfort. Absorbs vibration to protect your fitness equipment and floor surfaces from scratches. Lightweight, non-slip, water-resistant, easy to clean.

fields.F: ASUNA Minotaur Magnetic Commercial Indoor Cycling Bike
fields.N: 5 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
The ultimate performance is ASUNA 7150 Minotaur Commercial Indoor Cycling Bike. This indoor cycle is perfect for any gym or in-home use. This solid and sturdy bike is designed to perform at the highest levels and is excellent for high-intensity and steady-state types of training. Top-of-the-line engineering has gone into many details to make the riding experience more enjoyable and yield fitness results. The ergonomic handlebars deliver comfort and stability allowing for multiple hand positions. Narrow Q-Factor ensures superior biomechanics that improves comfort and cycling efficiency with every pedal stroke. Speed and momentum are achieved with the perfectly balanced 33 lb. high-grade aluminum and steel alloy flywheel. Magnetic resistance is precise and more responsive. Dual integrated gravity-weighted bottle holders keep you hydrated during your hardest workouts. Perfectly fit the bike to your body type with vertical and horizontal adjustments on the seat and handlebars.
• FEATURES: This cycling bike has a 33 lb aluminum and high alloy steel flywheel and is weighted for high inertia. The belt drive mechanism offers less maintenance and silent pedaling every time. Move up, down, Fore (forward), and Aft (backward) with the fully adjustable handlebar and seat (Inseam Min 30 / Max 38 in.). Multi-control resistance clicks with every tension level adjustment making it easier to follow along with your favorite cycling video.
• 186MM Q-FACTOR: The narrow Q-FACTOR offers superior bio-mechanics that improve comfort and optimal efficiency
• SAFETY: The patented seat and handlebar ensure the posts remain in place during your workout. High-grade aluminum posts reduce weight, making it easier to adjust. Front and rear foot levelers ensure stability on most surfaces.
• COMFORT AND DESIGN: Advanced ergonomic designed handlebars deliver a comfortable ride and allow for multiple hand positions. The dual-sided pedals are compatible with cycling shoes and will accommodate both high-performance clip-in cleats and traditional fitness shoes. Integrated non-slip slanted stretch plates will get your legs ready for an intense cycling session.
• EXTENDED RIDE COMFORT: The parallel seat rails run along the underside leaving the middle hollow for extra comfort and adaptability. Two Integrated gravity weight bottle holders fit up to 32 oz bottles.

fields.F: ASUNA Slim Folding Motorized Treadmill
fields.N: 5 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Save space and pack a powerful workout with the Slim Folding Motorized Treadmill by Asuna. Supporting up to 220 lb, this space-saving running deck (49Lx17.5W) is equipped with shock absorption technology that reduces the impact on your joints when you exercise. Powered by a 2.5-peak horsepower motor, the indoor treadmill can support walking and running speeds between 0.6mph and 8mph. Use the 4-window display to visualize your workout performance. Keep track of distance, time, calories burned, and speed at a glance. Make quick adjustments to speed by using the on-console quick buttons. And take advantage of the built-in pedometer to monitor your total steps during your exercise sessions. Control your workout entertainment by mounting your favorite smart device on the tablet holder. Bump up your workout with your favorite tunes when you connect your music player to the onboard MP3 sound system. Use the included folding tool to securely fold and unfold the treadmill in the instant. Designed with portability in mind, use the transportation wheels to move the treadmill, and store the motorized treadmill under raised surfaces. Use the folding tool that’s located on the base of the treadmill to fold the treadmill flat (measuring 64L x 30.5W x 4.5H inches when folded flat) and lock the frame in place.
• EASY-TO-USE DISPLAY: Watch your workout progress in real-time with the 4-window display. View your time, distance, speed, and calories burned all at the same time. Use the integrated pedometer to track your steps during each exercise session.
• EXTREMELY PORTABLE: This running treadmill can be easily and securely folded flat with the included folding key. Take advantage of the low-profile design, which makes it easy to slide the machine under surfaces and move it from room to room.
• FOLDING TOOL: Turn the tool counterclockwise in the frame locks to fold the treadmill frame. After it is folded, use the treadmill key to secure the frame in place. Keep the tool handy by placing it in its dedicated slot at the base of the treadmill.
• PLAY YOUR TUNES: Connect your music device to the onboard 3.5mm headphone port to listen to music through the integrated speakers on the treadmill. Mount your favorite devices on the treadmill by using the convenient tablet holder.
• STURDY BUILD: This treadmill supports a maximum user weight of 220 lbs. Reduce impact on your joints as you walk or run when you strike against the shock-absorption-equipped running deck, compared to exercising on concrete or other hard surfaces.
• POWERFUL MOTOR: This machine is powered by a 2.5-peak horsepower motor that supports speeds from 0.6mph to 8mph. Change your speed in an instant with the on-console quick buttons.
• VERSATILE TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: Two sets of transportation wheels allow you to move the treadmill forward, backward, left, and right when it’s folded flat. This makes it easier to move, position, and store the treadmill when it is not in use.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Zephyr Air Bike
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Build endurance and stamina with the SF-B2715 Zephyr Air Bike by Sunny Health and Fitness. Air resistance technology creates higher resistance making this workout machine low impact yet, completely intense. Achieve a full-body workout when utilizing the arm resistance handlebars while cycling. Track all of your fitness results on the digital monitor. Experience superior comfort on the Zephyr Bike with features that include: padded seating, adjustable seat and pedals, and rubber foam handles. The bike measures at a convenient 44L X 24W X 45H (inches). Achieve an incredible workout on The Zephyr Air Bike: the bike built to take punishment.
• DUAL BELT & CHAIN DRIVE MECHANISM: The Zephyr bike is constructed with both a chain and belt drive system. The fan wheel creates resistance through the belt-drive system which keeps the stationary bike quiet and low maintenance. The pedals are connected to the chain drive system giving you the feeling of an outdoor bike.
• SOLID CONSTRUCTION: The Zephyr Air Bike’s steel cage protects and keeps the resistance wheel intact while the heavy-duty frame construction keeps the bike durable during those vigorous workout sessions. The exercise bicycle is built with transportation wheels and rear stabilizers for added convenience. Max Weight - 240 LBS. FAN WHEEL Diameter at 18".
• DIGITAL MONITOR: The digital monitor tracks time, speed, rpm, distance and calories burned to give you an accurate reading of your progress. Place a mobile device on the tablet holder and follow along your favorite fitness videos.
• ADJUSTABLE HANDRAIL ARMS: High-density foam hand grips and slip resistant pedals lend to both comfort and performance. Adjustable handlebars maintain resistance helping to tone and sculpt muscles in you arms, back and shoulders.
• WIDE PADDED SADDLE: Extra padding on the wide padded saddle is designed to support your during long rides. The wide seat is adjustable in height to ensure you fit the pedals comfortably. Inseam: MIN 21.5 IN / MAX 33.5 IN
• ADJUSTABLE PEDAL STRAPS: Gripped pedals help you maintain balance and grip as your pedal for long durations. Easily adjust self leveling pedals to foot size for a custom fit.
• FULL BODY WORKOUT: Experience an incredible full-body workout as you use the cycling features combined with the resistance handlebars. Engage your core, shoulders, and back while exercising with the tension handles. Achieve a cardio workout while cycling at greater speeds.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness SunnyFit Bike Cadence - CB110
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Tracking your fitness has been made easy, get everything you need to accurately measure your cycling metrics with the Sunny Health & Fitness Exercise Cycling 2-in-1 Cadence + Speed Sensor - CB110. Installation is easy so you can stay focused on your exercise. This sensor is Bluetooth and ANT+ enabled which allows you to connect seamlessly with any mobile device. Use this to track your Cadence / RPM as well as your speed during indoor cycling or on the road while exercising outdoor! Two LED lights indicate the sensor's device connection: blue light signifies cadence mode and red light represents speed mode; please refer to the user manual for more details on the lights. Sync with the Sunny Health & Fitness SunnyFit® App for the best cycling experience.

fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Start a low-impact cardiovascular training routine with the SF- E3875 Programmable Elliptical Trainer by Sunny Health & Fitness. Stride confidently when you step onto the oversized textured footplates that are designed for optimal grip and balance. Crafted for long-lasting workouts, the durable steel frame on the elliptical cross trainer supports a maximum user weight of 300 lb. Grab the full motion handlebars that are equipped with anti-slip padding to build muscular endurance in your arm, shoulders, back, and chest. Use the pulse grips on the elliptical machine to track your heart rate in real-time. Striding in a controlled motion is a great solution for individuals searching for cardiovascular activities that can reduce the impact on the knees. Designed for dynamic workouts, you can work every muscle in your lower body. In comparison to stride length vs product length, this elliptical was designed to give you the longest stride length possible (19.5 inches), but with a shorter base length in order to provide a space-saving design. Increase workout intensity by adjusting the 16 levels of computerized resistance in a matter of taps. Use the integrated performance monitor to track your time, distance, speed, calories burned, heart rate, wattage production, and rotations per minute. Take advantage of 24 different program modes that can drive your training to the next level. Take advantage of the preset goal-driven workouts that base your performance on watt generation, BMI data, heart rate, and custom user values. Keep your favorite workout beverages close with the front-loaded bottle holder. Watch your favorite workout videos while you exercise when you place your device on the included tablet holder. When finished, easily move this indoor elliptical from one location to the next with the rubber transportation wheels.
• COMPUTERIZED RESISTANCE: Easily cycle between 16 levels of computerized resistance with a press of a button by using the on-console controls.
• PROGRAMS FOR FITNESS: Enjoy 24 presets that can power your fitness routine. Take advantage of the goal-oriented programs based on watt generation, BMI data, heart rate, and custom user values.
• MANUAL MODE: No electricity? No problem. This elliptical trainer can function without being plugged into a power source. When not plugged in, this elliptical exercise machine uses the last computerized resistance setting.
• TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: Use the rubber transportation wheels to easily roll the machine from room to room.
• PERFORMANCE MONITOR: Use the digital display to track time, distance, speed, calories burned, heart rate, wattage production, and rotations per minute.
• PULSE GRIPS: Monitor your heart rate in real-time when you grab onto the convenient heart rate sensors. you can use heart rate data in preset workouts to help you craft individual workouts, based on your intensity.
• STURDY DESIGN: This cardio trainer, which is designed for long-lasting workouts, has a solid steel frame and oversized floor pedals that support up to 300 lbs. Deliver smooth and powerful strides on the elliptical rail.
• DEVICE HOLDER: Be in control of your workout entertainment when you place your favorite personal device on the built-in tablet holder. Combine this elliptical with your favorite workout videos and in-workout applications.
• BOTTLE HOLDER: Staying hydrated has never been easier. Keep your favorite beverage in arm’s s reach when you use the built-in bottle holder.

fields.AU:
Never break your stride with the SF-T7515 Smart Treadmill with Auto recline by staying connected with Bluetooth and MP3 technology right at your fingertips. The SF-T7515 SMART TREADMILL with Auto recline is packed with state-of-the-art technology that will keep you engaged and connected. The large backlit LCD Monitor displays: Time, Distance, Speed, Calories, recline, and Heart Rate. The treadmill is equipped with 12 preset interval programs that manipulate time, speed, and recline. There are 3 countdown modes to target certain workout goals: Time, Distance, and Calories. User integrated Body Mass Index calculator will estimate body fat based on height and weight. BMI is a reference point for users to determine goals and fitness progressions when taken in different stages of training. Integrated speakers, microphone, Bluetooth and MP3 connectivity allows user to answer calls and listen to music. The ample running space allows users to run up to 8 miles per hour and to change recline up to 12%. The treadmill is equipped with preset buttons to quickly increase speed and/ or recline. The treadmill is easy to fold up and move with the built-in transportation wheels. The “Soft Drop System” makes unfolding the treadmill virtually seamless. Let Sunny Health and Fitness keep you moving and on target with the SF-T7515 Smart Treadmill with Auto recline.

fields.AU:
The adjustable pull-up station from Sunny Health & Fitness is a versatile, multi-functional accessory that can expand the capabilities of any home gym. With its sturdy steel construction and compact, space-saving footprint, this unit provides a complete full-body workout for building strength and muscle.The pull-up bar accommodates wide, neutral and hammer grip pull-ups to target the back, arms, and shoulders. The lower bar enables core exercises like leg and knee raises as well as tricep dips and push-ups for the chest, arms, and abs. Adjust the padded backrest to an inclined position to perform elevated push-ups working the upper chest and front deltoids. Users of any height can find the perfect position with the adjustable height settings.
【MULTI-FUNCTIONAL WORKOUT】 Perform core exercises like leg raises & knee raises using the lower bar. Do tricep dips & push-ups on the lower handles. Adjust to an inclined position for elevated push-ups that target the upper chest & shoulders.
【FULLY ADJUSTABLE】 The attachment height adjusts up and down to accommodate users of any height. The backrest also adjusts across 5 positions, moving forward and backward to provide optimal comfort and support.
【QUICK & EASY INSTALLATION】 No tools required for assembly. All necessary parts and clear instructions included. Easily fits with 2"x2" frame tubes, aligns with 5/6" or larger holes.
【SOFT PADDING & SIMPLE CLEANUP】 The workout attachment is designed with soft sweat-resistant padding that wipes down easily after workouts. The special padding prevents sweat from being absorbed.
【COMPATIBLE WITH SUNNY POWER RACKS】 Designed to easily attach to Sunny racks including the SF-XF9925, SF-9931, SF-9933, SF-920063, SF-921024, SF-921041, and SF-922059. Expand your home gym capabilities.

【Sunny Health & Fitness Commitment】 A top fitness brand for 20+ years, offers superior products and a dedication to excellence. Count on our committed customer service and trainers for the best fitness experience.

LIFT HEAVY AND TRAIN HARDER! Sunny Health & Fitness No. 076 Shark Clamp Lock Collars help you lift heavier without the hindrance of moving weight. fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Wood Plyo Box with Cover
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Enhance speed, force, and strength while fostering explosive power with the No.084 Wooden Plyo Box by Sunny Health and Fitness. Plyometric training is a very popular form of physical conditioning for those looking to combine strength and endurance training. The heavy-duty wooden plyometric box supports up to 500 lb max weight. Plyometric exercises target various muscle groups as you perform repeated extensions and contractions at maximal force. These types of exercises require your legs and core muscles to contract quickly helping generate maximum force with each leap. The three height levels allow you to change your routine which helps improve competitive performance and prepares your body for different exercises. Each side can be changed from 30”, 24”, and 20-inch height for a versatile and challenging plyometric training session. The plyometric jump box comes with a detachable vinyl-covered 1-inch foam padding cover. The tear-resistant cover can be reattached using the convenient Velcro along the edges of the entire covering. This padded one-inch foam located inside the padding gives you the option for extra support during jumps. Easily remove the covering off the wooden jump box as needed. Plyometric training is most effective when integrated systematically and executed 2-3 times per week. This type of exercise is also shown to improve the conditioning capacities of athletes involved in sports like volleyball, karate, and soccer. The plyo wooden box measures at 30 L X 24W X 20H while weighing an incredible 74 lb. Build strength and stamina with the Plyo Box by Sunny Health and Fitness.
• 3-in-1 PLYO BOX: The Plyo box can be moved to support three different heights at 30”, 24”, and 20” inches. The three heights allow you to add versatility to improve the conditioning capacities of athletes involved in soccer, volleyball, and soccer.
• HEAVY-DUTY FRAME: Enhance force as you jump on and off the sturdy wooden plyo box supporting 500 LBS. The wooden frame is designed with a tough exterior built for high-intensity interval training.
• DETACHABLE FOAM COVER: The plyometric jump box comes with a detachable vinyl-covered 1-inch foam padding cover. The tear-resistant cover can be reattached using the convenient Velcro.
• VERSATILE: Significantly increase upper and lower extremity anaerobic capacity through a versatility of squat jumps, push-ups, dips, and more!
• PERFORMANCE TRAINING: Improve physical fitness through vertical jumps, agility exercises, and plyometric drills. Unilateral and bilateral jump drills can help induce significant performance improvements during high-intensity plyometric training.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Slant Board
fields.N: 1 year structural frame, 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Unlock Better Mobility and Strength. The Sunny Health & Fitness Wood Slant Board is perfect for anyone looking to move better. If you have tight calves or limited ankle mobility, this board offers a simple way to stretch and recover. It’s also a powerful tool for "knees-over-toes" training and heel-elevated squats, helping you build stronger knees and better balance. With a 450 lb weight capacity and a high-traction surface, you can focus on your form without worrying about slipping. The anti-slide base keeps the board steady on any floor, making it a reliable addition to your home gym or rehab routine. Our board features five adjustable angles so you can customize your stretch or workout. When you're finished, it folds flat in seconds. Use the built-in handle to tuck it under a desk or take it to your next physical therapy session. Trust Sunny Health & Fitness to support your journey to better health and stronger legs.
【Loosen Tight Calves & Improve Movement】Stop letting stiff ankles hold you back. This slant board helps you deep-stretch your calves and Achilles to relieve pain from plantar fasciitis. It’s perfect for warming up before a run or improving your range of motion for smoother, deeper squats.
【4 Precision Stretching Angles】Take the guesswork out of your recovery. Choose from four specific incline levels (30°, 35°, 40°, and 45°) to target your calves, improve ankle dorsiflexion, or progress your ATG split squats. The adjustable design allows you to deepen your stretch safely at your own pace
【Heavy-Duty 450 Lbs. Capacity】Feel safe and steady while you train. Built with reinforced natural wood and strong steel hinges, this board is tough enough for everyone from beginners to heavy lifters. It won’t wobble or flex, even during weighted "knees-over-toes" exercises.
【Wide Non-Slip Platform】You don't have to worry about your feet slipping or feeling cramped. The large surface area gives you plenty of room for a wide stance or larger shoe sizes. The high-traction grip on top and anti-slide pads on the bottom keep you locked in place on any floor.
【Folds Flat & Easy to Carry】Space is never an issue. This board folds down completely flat so you can slide it under a bed or desk. It even has a built-in handle, making it easy to grab and take with you to the gym or your next physical therapy session.
【Est. in Sunny California since 2002】Sunny Health & Fitness delivers premium equipment with a commitment to quality. Backed by U.S.-based support and certified trainers, we offer a truly unmatched “Fit for Everyone” experience.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Balance Pad Large Blue
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Build better balance, stability, and core control with the Sunny Health & Fitness Foam Balance Pad. Designed with a soft, unstable surface, this versatile balance trainer helps engage the stabilizer muscles in your feet, ankles, legs, hips, and core during standing exercises, strength training, stretching, mobility work, and Pilates-style movement. Available in a 15.7" x 13" Large size and an extra-spacious 19.7" x 15.7" Extra Large size, the pad provides more room for comfortable foot placement, wider stances, kneeling positions, and smooth exercise transitions. High-density TPE foam delivers supportive cushioning while creating the controlled instability needed to challenge balance and body control. The textured surface helps support secure footing during single-leg stands, squats, lunges, planks, push-ups, and floor exercises. Its closed-cell construction helps resist moisture absorption for easier cleaning, while the lightweight design makes it simple to carry, store, and reposition. Supporting users up to 330 LB, this foam stability pad is a practical addition to home workouts for beginners and experienced users alike.
【IMPROVE BALANCE, STABILITY & CORE STRENGTH】 The soft, unstable foam surface challenges your body to stay controlled, helping engage the core and stabilizer muscles in the feet, ankles, legs, and hips during balance exercises and everyday workouts.
【LARGER SIZES FOR MORE ROOM TO MOVE】 Choose from a 15.7" x 13" Large pad or an extra-spacious 19.7" x 15.7" Extra Large pad. The wider training surface provides more room for comfortable foot placement, wider stances, kneeling positions, and exercise transitions.
【HIGH-DENSITY TPE FOAM】 Supportive, shape-recovering TPE foam delivers the controlled instability needed for balance training while cushioning your feet, knees, hands, and elbows during low-impact and floor-based exercises.
【TEXTURED NON-SLIP SURFACE】 The textured surface helps support secure footing and controlled movement during standing balance drills, squats, lunges, planks, push-ups, stretching, mobility work, and Pilates-style exercises.
【VERSATILE FULL-BODY TRAINING】 Add a new challenge to strength, mobility, flexibility, and core workouts. Use the stability pad for single-leg stands, kneeling exercises, planks, squats, lunges, stretching, or modifications of familiar movements.
【MOISTURE-RESISTANT & EASY TO CLEAN】 Closed-cell foam helps resist moisture absorption for easier care after workouts. Simply wipe the balance pad clean and allow it to dry before storing it indoors.
【LIGHTWEIGHT SUPPORT FOR HOME WORKOUTS】 Easy to carry, reposition, and store, this portable balance trainer supports beginners and experienced users alike and holds up to 330 LB for dependable indoor fitness training.

fields.AU:
Build balance, core control, and everyday stability with the Sunny Health & Fitness Balance Cushion. This inflatable wobble cushion creates a gently unstable surface that helps challenge the feet, ankles, legs, hips, and core during balance drills, seated core work, foot stimulation, and movement breaks.Use the included pump to adjust the firmness for your routine—slightly softer for seated or foot use, or firmer for balance and stability training. Dual-textured surfaces provide non-slip grip, tactile feedback, and massage-like pressure stimulation.Compact, portable, and easy to wipe clean, this 13-inch PVC balance disc supports up to 330 lb and is easy to use at home, in the office, in the car, or in a workout space.
【BUILD BALANCE FROM THE GROUND UP】 This inflatable balance cushion challenges the feet, ankles, legs, and hips to stay controlled on an unstable surface, helping users practice coordination, stability, and body awareness during standing balance drills and movement routines.

【ADJUSTABLE FIRMNESS WITH INCLUDED PUMP】 Use the included pump to add or release air and customize the cushion’s firmness for your routine. Keep it slightly softer for seated or foot use, or add more air for a firmer feel during balance and stability training, while avoiding overinflation.
【DUAL-TEXTURED SURFACE FOR GRIP & FEEDBACK】 Designed with textured surfaces on both sides, this core balance disc provides non-slip grip, tactile feedback, and massage-like pressure stimulation during standing balance work, seated movement, and foot or body contact exercises.

Made with high-density PVC foam material for greater durability and comfort. It features a soft, textured base, perfect for vibration and noise reduction. The Sunny Health & Fitness Treadmill Mat is lightweight, non-slip, water-resistant, and very easy to clean.
• DURABILITY: This heavy-duty, durable and waterproof exercise mat prolongs the life of your equipment by helping prevent floor and carpet dust from entering belts and mechanical parts.
• HEAVY-DUTY MATERIAL: Made with high-density PVC foam material for greater durability and comfort. Absorbs vibration to protect your fitness equipment and floor surfaces from scratches. Lightweight, non-slip, water-resistant, easy to clean.
• SPACE SAVER & ERGONOMIC: Simply roll your equipment mat and store it away in a utility closet or under the bed when not in use.
• VERSATILE: Excellent for Tumbling, Exercise Programs, Pilates, Stretching, Yoga, Martial Arts, Gymnastics, Day Care Activities and many other uses.
• CONVENIENT SIZE & WATERPROOF: The fitness floor mat is perfect for indoor cycling bikes and ellipticals. The mat is also waterproof and sweat-resistant, so you can easily clean it with a damp cloth.
• AVAILABLE IN FOUR (4) SIZE OPTIONS: NO. 074-XS (XS): 30L X 20W X 0.16H In, NO. 083 (S): 51L x 23.5W x 0.16H in, NO. 074-M (M): 79L x 35.5W x 0.16H in, NO. 074-L (L): 90.5L x 39.5W x 0.16H in

Since this machinery is available in various sizes our mats are offered in Extra Small, Small, Medium, and Large sizes to best support your home gym accommodations.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Row-N-Ride® Plus Assisted Squat Machine - NO. 077PLUS
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Three adjustable squat depths, set at 30°, 60°, and 90°, allow for a tailored workout experience. The built-in LCD monitor tracks calories burned, workout time, and reps, keeping you informed as you exercise. Three resistance levels and adjustable handlebars provide a personalized workout to accommodate users of various sizes.
• DIGITAL MONITOR: Stay focused on your goals and track your progress with the Digital Monitor which tracks: Calories, Count, Reps/Min, Time and includes a Scan function.
• ERGONOMIC HANDLES: Curved, contoured handles add potential variations to your grip and workouts Ergonomic design aids in comfort when performing assisted squats.
• EXTRA RESISTANCE: Featuring 4 resistance bands rated at 22 LB each, the Row-N-Ride Plus increases the intensity of your assisted squats and helps to shape your glutes, thighs, and legs.
• HIGH MAX WEIGHT: This foldable squat assist exercise equipment is designed for powerful workouts. A 300 LB max weight gives you the confidence to push for the extra rep and go the distance.
• PADDED SEAT: The thick and supple cushioned seat provides just the right amount of support. It supports 4 levels of lateral adjustability and 3 levels of default incline positions.
fields.AV:
Sunny Health & Fitness Upright Row-N-Ride Rowing Machine

Develop strength, speed and leanness with the Sunny Health & Fitness No. 077 Home Squat Machine. Strengthen not only you lower body but you shoulders, arms and back, this exerciser promotes compound movement (two or more muscle groups working cohesively). Activating groups of muscles together requires more strength, so you'll burn more calories. Compound exercises bring compounded results! With 3 adjustable resistance bands, intensify you workout by adding or subtracting bands, each band adds approx. 22 pounds of resistance!

  • WHY SQUAT: Squats are not only effective for building an insanely strong lower body, but also because they deliver a number of ancillary physical benefits, including increased hormone release and improved flexibility.
  • HOW IT WORKS: Tone the lower body by using your glutes, quads, and hamstrings to push down to a squat. Work your shoulders, back and chest as you push yourself up through every rep. Skip the weights, this squat trainer will reduce the amount of stress on the knees and joints that occurs when you squat incorrectly. Adding this to you workout will help you develop proper form to get the perfect squat.
  • TRACK you FITNESS: LCD monitor tracks you calories, scan, time and count. This trainer gives you the freedom to add or remove tension, the three elastic bands can be clipped on or off the seat to adjust to any fitness level.
  • WORKOUT VARIETY: Not only does it offer the ability to do a full-range squat but you can also add variety by doing high, median and low zone squats pulses.
  • CONVENIENCE: Easily store almost anywhere in you home. Remove the knob, fold and store; as easy as 1, 2, 3. Its self leveling pedals help you to get in and out of bike in a breeze. Stable end caps prevent any movement to ensure you have a stable and safe workout.
  • ADJUSTABLE: Padded handle and saddle distance control adjusts to you body length to develop proper technique. Not only can you adjust the saddle proximity to the handlebar but it comes equipped with saddle angle control, which allows you to adjust the saddle at 30, 60 and 90 degrees giving you deeper squat positions.

Its ergonomic rocker mechanism provides deep, targeted stretches to aid in muscle recovery and injury prevention. Built with a slip-resistant, durable design, it ensures stability during use and is lightweight for easy portability. Suitable for all fitness levels, it includes a comprehensive stretching guide for optimal results. Backed by over 20 years of expertise, this reliable tool supports your wellness journey at home, the gym, or on the go.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness 20" Olympic Single Dumbbell Handlebar with Ring Collars
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Change up your strength workout with the OB-20 Olympic dumbbell with locking ring collars. This solid heavy-duty bar is designed for the beginner to the advanced fitness enthusiast. It has a weight capacity of up to 150 lb to allow for linear progressive strength gains. The rotating sleeves release torque created by the weight and movement making it safer on the joints. The locking ring collars will secure the weights in place to make working out safer. Get two and perform dumbbell chest presses, shoulder presses, and use just one to perform triceps kickbacks and single-arm bicep curls. Never miss your workout with the ergonomic dumbbells built for the toughest workouts. Start training today with the OB20 Olympic Dumbbell by Sunny Health and Fitness.
• Increase the intensity of your arm workout with the Olympic Dumbbell for all fitness enthusiasts.
• Rotating sleeves allow the weight plates to rotate as you move the bar. This provides a more secure grip and reduces stress on your wrists and elbows
• Locking Ring Collars to keep everything secure and in place for stability and safety
• Diamond knurled handles are comfortable so you're won't shred up your hands while lifting heavier weights. Knurling is optimal for supplementing your own grip strength and helping correct hand placement.
• Accommodates Olympic weight plates with 2-inch center holes up to a maximum combined weight of 150LBS

fields.AU:
Fight against a sedentary lifestyle with the easily transportable and fully assembled P2030 Pink Magnetic Under Desk Elliptical by Sunny Health & Fitness. This space-saving exercise machine can help get your legs moving in a forward motion. Large textured foot pedals prevent slippage while in use. This elliptical is excellent for increasing blood circulation, joint range of motion, and improved lower body muscular endurance. Use the tension knob to select 8 levels of belt drive magnetic resistance paired with a low maintenance design to provide a wide variety of exercise intensities to fit your specific needs. Use the central digital monitor to track speed, time, calories, and distance, or choose the scan function to cycle through all workout variables. The 7-inch stride length moves smoothly with integrated wheels along with the stable frame. Use the floor stabilizers for an even placement on floor surfaces. Measuring at 24L x 19W x 11H inches these low profile and compact exercise machines can be placed anywhere you choose to sit. Weighing only 25 pounds and equipped with a conveniently centered transportation handlebar, you can easily pick up and move this elliptical with ease. This under-desk elliptical arrives fully assembled! Convenient pre-assembly means you can save time, money, and energy on putting together your elliptical, simply unbox and begin your fitness journey!

• 8 LEVELS OF RESISTANCE: Chose between 8 levels of magnetic resistance using the tension knob to provide increased levels of intensity to your workout as you build muscular endurance.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Upright Row-N-Ride® Exerciser in Pink – P2100
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Develop strength, speed, and leanness with the Sunny Health & Fitness P2100 Home Squat Machine in Pink! Strengthen not only your lower body but your shoulders, arms, and back, this exerciser promotes compound movement (two or more muscle groups working cohesively). Activating groups of muscles together require more strength, so you'll burn more calories. Compound exercises bring compounded results! With 3 adjustable resistance bands, intensify your workout by adding or subtracting bands, each band adds approx. 22 pounds of resistance!
• WHY SQUAT: Squats are not only effective for building an insanely strong lower body, but also because they deliver a number of ancillary physical benefits, including increased hormone release and improved flexibility.
• HOW IT WORKS: Tone the lower body by using your glutes, quads, and hamstrings to push down to a squat. Work your shoulders, back, and chest as you push yourself up through every rep. Skip the weights, this squat trainer will reduce the amount of stress on the knees and joints that occurs when you squat incorrectly. Adding this to your workout will help you develop a proper form to get the perfect squat.
• TRACK YOUR FITNESS: The LCD monitor tracks your calories, scan, time, and count. This trainer gives you the freedom to add or remove tension, the three elastic bands can be clipped on or off the seat to adjust to any fitness level.
• WORKOUT VARIETY: Not only does it offer the ability to do a full-range squat but you can also add variety by doing high, median and low zone squats pulses.
• CONVENIENCE: Easily store almost anywhere in your home. Remove the knob, fold, and store; as easy as 1, 2, 3. Its self-leveling pedals help you to get in and out of the bike in a breeze. Stable end caps prevent any movement to ensure you have a stable and safe workout.
• ADJUSTABLE: Padded handle and saddle distance control adjust to your body length to develop the proper technique. Not only can you adjust the saddle proximity to the handlebar but it comes equipped with saddle angle control, which allows you to adjust the saddle at 30, 60, and 90 degrees giving you deeper squat positions.

fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Turn short sessions into real results. The Sunny Health & Fitness Foldable Smart Cardio Step Climber (P2530) uses bodyweight for low-impact cardio that works legs, glutes, and core. An extended 9.8"– 24.8" step range with a 21.5" stride lets you choose your reach while the start point stays fixed; no preset resistance means your core handles the stabilizing. Four handlebar positions help you find a steady, ergonomic grip, and the triangular frame folds fast for easy storage. Connect via Bluetooth to the SunnyFit® App for guided climbs, scenic routes, and progress tracking. The simple LCD shows time, steps, step rate, and calories so you can stay focused on the climb.
【TOTAL-BODY CARDIO AND STRENGTH】 Build endurance while toning key muscles. The smooth, low-impact climb keeps legs, glutes, and core working without beating up your joints.
【CLIMB HIGHER WHEN YOU WANT】 The stepper offers 9.8"– 24.8" of vertical travel (21.5" stride), so you decide how high to lift each step. The starting position stays put; your legs set the effort.
【BALANCE AND CORE ON EVERY STEP】 Each climb trains stability and control. With no preset resistance, your core naturally takes charge to keep you steady.
【COACHING THAT MEETS YOU WHERE YOU ARE】The SunnyFit app offers structured climbs, real-time metrics, scenic routes, and AI adaptive plans that adjust to your body data and progress.
【COMFORTABLE, ERGONOMIC FIT】 Four  handlebar positions help you find your ideal hand height and posture, giving steady support for users of different sizes.
【KNOW YOUR NUMBERS AT A GLANCE】 An easy-read LCD tracks count, total count, time, calories, and scan mode, giving you clear feedback to monitor your progress without breaking your rhythm.
【SOLID FROM THE GROUND UP】 A heavy-duty triangular frame supports up to 330 lb, delivering a stable, confidence-boosting ride from warm-up to long sessions.
【FOLDS AWAY WHEN YOU’RE DONE】 Quick to stow and easy to live with—perfect for apartments, shared spaces, and compact home gyms.
【SHIFT THE MUSCLE FOCUS】 Tilt-adjustable footplates let you aim the work toward calves, quads, or glutes so your workouts never feel the same.
【EST. IN SUNNY CALIFORNIA SINCE 2002】Sunny Health & Fitness delivers premium equipment with a commitment to quality. Backed by U.S.-based support and certified trainers, we offer a truly unmatched “Fit for Everyone” experience.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Upright Row-N-Ride® Exerciser
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Develop strength, speed, and leanness with the Sunny Health & Fitness No. 077S Home Squat Machine. Strengthen not only your lower body but your shoulders, arms, and back, this exerciser promotes compound movement (two or more muscle groups working cohesively). Activating groups of muscles together require more strength, so you'll burn more calories. Compound exercises bring compounded results! With 3 adjustable resistance bands, intensify your workout by adding or subtracting bands, each band adds approx. 22 pounds of resistance!
• WHY SQUAT: Squats are not only effective for building an insanely strong lower body, but also because they deliver a number of ancillary physical benefits, including increased hormone release and improved flexibility.
• HOW IT WORKS: Tone the lower body by using your glutes, quads, and hamstrings to push down to a squat. Work your shoulders, back, and chest as you push yourself up through every rep. Skip the weights, this squat trainer will reduce the amount of stress on the knees and joints that occurs when you squat incorrectly. Adding this to your workout will help you develop a proper form to get the perfect squat.
• TRACK YOUR FITNESS: The LCD monitor tracks your calories, scan, time, and count. This trainer gives you the freedom to add or remove tension, the three elastic bands can be clipped on or off the seat to adjust to any fitness level.
• WORKOUT VARIETY: Not only does it offer the ability to do a full-range squat but you can also add variety by doing high, median and low zone squats pulses.
• CONVENIENCE: Easily store almost anywhere in your home. Remove the knob, fold, and store; as easy as 1, 2, 3. Its self-leveling pedals help you to get in and out of the bike in a breeze. Stable end caps prevent any movement to ensure you have a stable and safe workout.
• ADJUSTABLE: Padded handle and saddle distance control adjust to your body length to develop the proper technique. Not only can you adjust the saddle proximity to the handlebar but it comes equipped with saddle angle control, which allows you to adjust the saddle at 30, 60, and 90 degrees giving you deeper squat positions.

fields.AU:
The Sunny Health & Fitness Foldable 180° Leg Stretcher Machine makes it easier to improve flexibility, increase mobility, and work toward deeper split positions with better control. Designed for beginners and more experienced users alike, it features a one-handed handbrake system that lets you adjust stretch intensity gradually, helping you train at a pace that feels safe and manageable.With a full 180° stretch range, 6 adjustable length settings, and a design that fits both kids and adults, this stretcher supports a wide range of flexibility levels and training goals. The reinforced steel frame, cushioned seat, and padded leg supports help create a more stable and comfortable stretching experience during every session. Its foldable, space-saving design makes it easy to use in home gyms, bedrooms, apartments, or smaller workout areas, then store away neatly when not in use. You’ll also get free access to the SunnyFit App, which includes trainer-led workouts, guided programs, and progress tools to support your overall fitness journey. Backed by Sunny Health & Fitness, this stretcher is built to help you move better, stretch more confidently, and stay consistent at home.
SAFE STRETCHING, STEADY PROGRESS: Build flexibility with more confidence using a leg stretcher designed for controlled training. Great for beginners and advanced users working toward better mobility, deeper stretches, and safer split progress at home.
DEEPER SPLITS WITH BETTER CONTROL: The full 180° split range helps target inner thighs, hamstrings, and hip flexors for more effective flexibility training. A practical way to work toward deeper split positions with steady, gradual progress over time.
ADJUST TO YOUR COMFORT LEVEL: The one-handed handbrake system lets you control stretch intensity more gradually through each session. This helps reduce sudden movements and makes it easier to stretch at a pace that feels right for your body.
MADE TO FIT MORE USERS: With 6 adjustable length settings, this stretcher adapts to different heights, body sizes, and flexibility levels. A versatile option for kids, teens, and adults training for dance, gymnastics, martial arts, yoga, or general mobility.
COMFORTABLE, STABLE SUPPORT: A reinforced steel frame, cushioned seat, and padded leg supports help create a more secure and comfortable stretching experience. Built to support up to 350 lbs with reduced wobble for dependable home use.
FOLDABLE FOR EASY STORAGE: The compact foldable design makes setup simple and storage easier between workouts. A smart fit for home gyms, bedrooms, apartments, or smaller training spaces.
MORE WAYS TO STAY MOTIVATED: Includes free access to the SunnyFit App with trainer-led workouts, guided programs, and progress tools to support your flexibility and overall fitness journey.

fields.AU:
Get a heart-pumping, calorie-busting, intense workout all from the comfort of your couch with the Sunny Health & Fitness Magnetic Mini Exercise Cycle SF-B020026. Push your cycle session as vigorously as you desire; the suction cups will ensure your mini exercise bike is solid and will not slip. Use while relaxing on a chair, in the comfort of your living room, sitting at work in the office, or even on vacation! The convenient carrying handle and relative lightweight makes working out on the go possible.

• EFFICIENCY: The 7-inch stride enables a much more efficient workout than other mini exercise bikes with shorter strides.
• NON-SLIP PEDALS: The pedals include adjustable straps and doubles as handlebars for a full body cardio workout.

Sunny Health & Fitness Smart Motorized Under Desk Cycle
fields.AU:
The Sunny Health & Fitness Smart Motorized Mini Exercise Bike is a compact, low-impact exerciser designed to make daily movement easier from the comfort of your chair. Use it for either arm or leg exercise to add gentle activity to your day without needing a full cardio machine or large workout space.
Its motorized design helps provide smooth assisted movement, making it a practical option for seated exercise, light daily activity, and users who want a more supportive way to stay moving. With 18 speed levels, 6 preset programs, and the ability to change direction forward or backward with one click, it is easy to adjust each session to a pace that feels comfortable and convenient.
The fully assembled, small-footprint design makes it easy to place under a desk, near a sofa, or beside your favorite chair, so movement fits more naturally into your routine. A wireless remote control lets you adjust speed and settings without bending down, while Bluetooth connectivity adds access to the SunnyFit App for guided sessions and real-time metrics. The display also enters sleep mode after 10 minutes of inactivity for simple, energy-saving use at home.
LOW-IMPACT MOVEMENT FROM YOUR CHAIR: Keep your arms or legs active with one compact motorized exerciser designed for seated workouts. A simple way to add gentle daily movement at home without needing a full cardio machine.
MOTORIZED OR MANUAL MOTION: Choose smooth motor-assisted movement for added support, or use the exerciser manually to power the pedals at your own pace. Both modes make it easy to adapt your routine to your comfort and activity level.
SUPPORTS EVERYDAY MOBILITY: Regular upper- or lower-body movement can help encourage circulation, maintain flexibility, and keep muscles engaged during seated exercise, wellness routines, or light activity.
FULLY ASSEMBLED AND EASY TO MOVE: The small-footprint design comes ready to use and is easy to place where you need it most. Great for under-desk exercise, living rooms, home offices, or any space where seated movement fits your routine.
MADE FOR EVERYDAY USE: This versatile exerciser can be used in multiple settings, including under a desk while you work. A practical way to stay more active throughout the day with movement that fits easily into your schedule.
MOTORIZED SUPPORT FOR ARM AND LEG EXERCISE: The motorized design helps provide smooth passive movement for either arms or legs, making it a great option for gentle daily exercise and users who want added support during workouts.
CHOOSE A PACE THAT FEELS RIGHT: With 18 speed levels, forward and backward motion, and the option to control settings manually or with the remote, it is easy to find a routine that feels comfortable and convenient.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Under Desk Magnetic Cycle
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Make room for physical activity when you're sitting with the Sunny Health & Fitness SF-B0891 Under Desk Magnetic Cycle. Slide your feet onto the pedals with an adjustable strap. Achieve a 7-inch stride length smoothly, quietly, and consistently on this under desk machine while you're seated. We crafted this machine around silence. Engage the smooth belt-drive mechanism and the 3.52 lb flywheel as you pedal forward. The pedals have a peak height of 10 inches and a bottom height of 3 inches, when on the ground. Use this machine as a low-impact exercise alternative that can help engage your lower body with little joint stress. The pedals can also be used as handgrips. you can use this machine on a desk-level surface and pedal your arms to promote upper-body activity. Exercise without being tied to a plug. Stay in control of your seated workout cadence with the manually-powered design. Track your speed, time, distance, and calories burned in real-time with the battery-powered exercise display. Cycle through 8 levels of magnetic tension that is controlled by a responsive dial. Weighing just over 19 lb, this machine can be moved easily with a sturdy hand grip. Easily store your under-desk machine (20.5L x 16.5W x 10.5H) in a bedroom, office, or the trunk of your car. Make your next low-impact exercise a quiet and consistent one with the Sunny Health & Fitness Under Desk Magnetic Cycle.
• LOW IMPACT: This under desk elliptical is a great way to incorporate lower body movement without putting pressure on joints. Enjoy a 7-inch stride while you're seated at work.
• SMOOTH OPERATION: The Belt-drive mechanism and the 3.52lbs flywheel makes each stride simple.
• EASY TO STORE: Measuring 20.5 inches long and 10.5 inches tall, this under-desk elliptical is easy to store under a desk. Use the integrated handgrip to pick up the machine. Weighing just over 19lbs, you'll be able to move it anywhere.
• MAGNETIC RESISTANCE: Bump up the exercise intensity in a matter of seconds as you cycle through 8 levels of magnetic tension. Each level makes it progressively harder to complete a stride, which makes it where you can burn more calories.
• 2-IN-1 DESIGN: Switch up your exercise when you use this machine on a desk-level surface. Engage muscle groups in your upper body as you pedal forward with your arms.
• EASY-TO-READ DISPLAY: Track your activity data, such as speed, time, distance, and calories burned with the battery-powered exercise display.
• MANUAL OPERATION: With this machine, you're in control of your speed. There’s no need to be plugged into the wall to operate the machine.

fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Whether you're looking for the cycle class experience at home, or you're an avid outdoor cyclist who wants to stay in riding shape during bad weather, our Sunny Health & Fitness SF-B1002 Belt Drive Indoor Cycling Bike is just what you're looking for. The 49 Ibs. flywheel produces the same feeling as if you're pedaling a road bike. This cycle bike provides full customizability from adjusting the handlebars, seat, and resistance; it gives you full control of your workout!
• STATIONARY EXERCISE BIKE: The sturdy steel frame, heavy 49 lb weighted flywheel, and 275 maximum user weight gives this bike a rock solid build that will keep it moving ride after ride. Easily move the indoor cycle from room to room with the front-mounted transportation wheels. Stay hydrated throughout your workout. This convenient bottle holder is built into the frame for easy access.
• RESISTANCE: Feel the hills throughout your ride. The cycle bike trainer features a resistance system that gives you the experience of a realistic, real-road feeling. The built-in pushdown emergency brake will bring the bike to an immediate stop. Make your workout more intense and burn more calories by cycling at a high resistance level.
• SILENT RIDE: Experience a smooth and quiet ride with the maintenance-free belt drive system which allows you to work out without interrupting your workout or anyone around you.
• CUSTOMIZABILITY: Adjust the seat vertically and horizontally. Handlebars move up and down to adapt to any user type. Inseam measures Min 31 in / Max 42 in. Designed to keep your feet in place, these pedals are built with toe cages. Make this bike your very own with total customizability.
• BOTTLE HOLDER: Stay hydrated throughout your workout. This convenient bottle holder is built into the frame for easy access
• ADJUSTABLE HANDLEBARS: 2-Way adjustable handlebars for fit and comfort.
• TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: Easily move this bike across your home with the built-in transportation wheels that are designed to roll across home surfaces.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Synergy Pro Magnetic Indoor Cycling Bike - SF-B1851
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Start a new in-home fitness routine with the SF-B1851 Synergy Pro Magnetic Indoor Cycling Bike. Ergonomically designed, this bike has a rounded multi-grip handlebar and 4-way adjustable seat that can help maintain your comfort and stability while you exercise. Cycling on an indoor bike is a low-impact exercise that can strengthen your cardiovascular performance and engage muscles in your arms, core, and legs.
• INERTIA-READY FLYWHEEL: The large 40-pound flywheel is designed to store moving energy that keeps you pedaling consistently during your cycling workout. The onboard magnetic brakes can bring the wheel to a stop instantly.
• BELT-DRIVE MECHANISM: This bike has a durable belt-drive mechanism that is smooth and consistent, allowing you to focus more on your performance while you're on the bike.
• MAGNETIC RESISTANCE: The integrated magnetic resistance puts you in full control of your workout intensity. It delivers consistent performance that makes your workout easy when you want it, hard when you need it.
• PULSE-SENSING GRIPS: Monitor your cardiovascular performance with the built-in pulse-sensing grips so you can actively check your workout progress, displayed on the performance monitor.
• DUMBBELL HOLDER: Use this cycling exercise bike in tandem with dumbbells (not included) to engage muscles in your upper body and core while you cycle. You can place them onto the built-in dumbbell holders when they are not in use (up to 20b).
• BUILT FOR COMFORT: Customize the bike to your height with the 4-way adjustable seat and 2-way adjustable handlebars. Maximize your cycling stability when you place your feet in the toe cages or on the clipless style pedals.
• WORKOUT ANALYSIS: Monitor your workout efficiency when you track your average and max speed and cadence on the built-in performance monitor. Use the speed and cadence data to assess and analyze your general fitness progress or cycling performance.
• MEASURE THE DISTANCE: Accurately calculate your personal cycling distance in both miles and kilometers to track a variety of different training and race distances.
• PRESET WORKOUTS: Take advantage of 3 preset workout modes to help you reach your cardiovascular goals through challenging time, distance, pace, and calorie-based intervals. Each preset will help you evaluate your progress.

fields.AU:
Power your next cardiovascular exercise with the SF-B1913 Training Cycling Bike by Sunny Health and Fitness. Keep your feet secure by using the universal toe cages or by using clip-in compatible footwear. Tailor the bike by adjusting the 4-way adjustable bike seat and handlebars (leg inseam 29 inches to 39 inches). Take hold of the multi-grip handlebars to switch up your riding style and reduce fatigue during long rides in one grip position. Grab the hand pulse sensors on the handlebars to monitor your heart rate for increased cardiovascular workout efficiency. Enjoy a smooth and quiet belt-drive mechanism that engages the hefty 44 -pound flywheel. Designed with magnetic resistance, this indoor cycle bike can apply resistance precisely with its micro-adjustment knob—or swiftly bring the flywheel to a complete stop by pressing on the knob. Use the onboard performance monitor to track your speed, cadence, distance, calories, time, and pulse. you can also use the performance monitor on the exercise bike to activate two target modes (time and distance), and a customizable race mode to test your personal records. Mount your favorite personal device on the spacious tablet holder. Keep your workout beverage nearby when you place it in the bottle holder. Ride confidently and intensely thanks to the heavy-duty hexagonal steel tube frame, which can support up to 300 lb. Take advantage of the floor levelers that increase riding stability when you ride on a variety of floor surfaces. After you work out, use the transportation wheels to move the bike from room to room for easy storage.

• BELT-DRIVE: Enjoy a smooth, silent, and dependable machine that can drive the 44-pound flywheel. The belt drive requires little maintenance and will allow you to focus more on riding and less on maintenance.

• STABILITY: This magnetic belt drive bike is designed to keep you leveled throughout your entire ride. Take advantage of the unique tube system and the adaptable floor levelers that help maintain stability during your workout.

fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Sunny Health & Fitness Performance Interactive Series Upright Bike is the perfect product for anyone looking to get into indoor cycling for the first time. Ergonomically designed, this stationary indoor bike has rounded grip handlebars and adjustable seating that can help maintain your comfort and stability while riding at home. Connect to the bike with your mobile device via Bluetooth and access our SunnyFit® App’s cycling programs and guided workouts led by our certified trainers. Cycling on an indoor exercise bike is a low-impact exercise that can strengthen your cardiovascular performance and engage muscles in your arms, core, and legs. With a simple twist of a knob, adjust the magnetic resistance with load depending on how much effort you want to put in per indoor cycling session. What are you waiting for?
• SMART FITNESS: With Bluetooth connectivity, the SunnyFit® App allows you to access an array of free cycling and fitness programs for all levels. Track your fitness and cycle along with Sunny Health & Fitness expert trainers on the SunnyFit® App. Connect your preferred mobile device through Bluetooth and view your performance metrics in real-time.
• SunnyFit® App: The all-new SunnyFit® App takes your Sunny workouts to the next level! View your live metrics displayed in real-time as you tour the world with real location maps. Get the results you want with customized workout plans. Explore 500+ workout videos that fit your schedule and goals. Compare your results on the exercise bike leaderboard, share your fitness experiences, get workout tips, and much more!
• MAGNETIC RESISTANCE: An 8-level contactless resistance using internal magnets offers a much smoother ride compared to felt, leather, or other types of contact resistance mechanisms.
• 4-WAY ADJUSTABLE SEAT: Built for comfort, the seat is fully adjustable. Adjust the seat up-down or front-back, depending on your height and comfort. It integrates a consistent layer of support and has a longitudinal groove to promote a healthy blood flow.
• HEART RATE SENSOR: Monitor your cardiovascular performance with the built-in pulse-sensing grips so you can actively check your workout progress, displayed on the digital monitor.
• DEVICE HOLDER: Control your indoor workout entertainment as well as your learning experiences with the SunnyFit® App directly in front of you. The built-in device holder enables you to play your favorite movies or follow your favorite Sunny bike workout.
• TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: Simply tilt and roll out for use or away for storage, no need for heavy lifting or muscle strain. The wheels at the front of the unit allow the user to move their equipment around with ease.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Tornado Smart Advanced Air Bike
fields.AU:
Bring full-body cardio home with the Sunny Health & Fitness Smart Advanced Air Resistance Bike. Progressive air resistance increases as you pedal, push, and pull harder, making it ideal for HIIT, intervals, endurance, and conditioning.
A 22.8" fan with six wide curved blades creates strong airflow as effort rises, while long-range moving handlebars support upper- and lower-body training from seated or standing positions. The bike also uses 22 sealed cartridge bearings to support smooth movement throughout the workout. The 4-way adjustable seat helps personalize fit, while weighted self-leveling pedals support easier foot placement. Track RPM, speed, time, distance, calories, and pulse on the onboard monitor, with metric or imperial units. Connect to the free SunnyFit App for expanded tracking, including watts, heart rate, progress, and additional workouts. Built with a 330 lb capacity, floor stabilizers, transport wheels, device holder, and bottle holder for convenient home training.
【PROGRESSIVE RESISTANCE THAT RISES WITH YOUR EFFORT】Air resistance responds naturally as you pedal, push, and pull harder, letting you move from steady cardio to demanding HIIT, sprints, and conditioning without stopping to adjust a resistance knob.
【FULL-BODY HIIT CARDIO FROM SEATED OR STANDING POSITIONS】 Combine moving handlebars with pedaling to bring the upper and lower body into the workout. Train seated for steady cardio or stand for more dynamic HIIT intervals and conditioning.
【SIX WIDE CURVED FAN BLADES FOR STRONGER AIRFLOW】The 22.8" fan uses six wide, streamlined curved blades designed to move strong airflow as cadence rises, helping resistance become progressively more demanding as you push harder.
【LONG-RANGE HANDLEBARS FOR MORE UPPER-BODY ENGAGEMENT】Approximately 20.5" of push-pull travel helps involve the arms, shoulders, back, and core, while ergonomic grips support comfortable movement through seated and standing workouts..
【TRACK PERFORMANCE & TRAIN WITH SUNNYFIT】Monitor RPM, speed, time, distance, calories, pulse, and more with metric or imperial units. Connect to the free SunnyFit App for watts, heart rate, progress tracking, trainer-led workouts, and additional training options.
【PERSONALIZED FIT WITH 330 LB SUPPORT & SMOOTH CONSTRUCTION】A 4-way adjustable seat helps accommodate users approximately 5'1" to 6'7", while 22 sealed cartridge bearings support smooth movement. Includes floor stabilizers, transport wheels, device holder, and bottle holder for everyday home training.
【20+ YEARS OF SUNNY FITNESS EXPERIENCE】 Train with confidence from Sunny Health & Fitness, backed by more than 20 years of fitness equipment experience and dedicated U.S.-based customer support.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Programmable SMART Upright Bike
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Build a more guided cardio routine at home with the Sunny Health & Fitness Programmable Electromagnetic Smart Upright Bike with App Control. Designed for low-impact seated cycling, this smart upright bike combines 16 levels of electromagnetic resistance, 24 built-in programs, and SunnyFit app resistance control to help make each ride more structured and easier to follow. Connect to the free SunnyFit to sync key ride data, including duration, calories, distance, speed, RPM, and resistance, while adjusting resistance through the in-app interface during your workout. The LCD console keeps important feedback visible, including watt, pulse, odometer, recovery, and more. A wide padded comfort seat adjusts up, down, forward, and backward to help support your riding fit, while self-leveling pedals with adjustable straps keep your feet supported. Add light upper-body movement with the included resistance bands, then use the built-in tablet holder, bottle holder, dumbbell storage rack, floor levelers, and front transport wheels for convenient daily home use. Built to support up to 300 lb.
【SMART PROGRAMMABLE CARDIO FOR HOME】 Build a more guided cardio routine with a smart upright bike designed for low-impact seated cycling. Built-in programs, adjustable resistance, and connected workout tracking help make home cardio feel more structured and easier to follow.
【16 ELECTROMAGNETIC RESISTANCE LEVELS & 24 PROGRAMS】 Move from easy warmups to more challenging rides with 16 levels of motorized electromagnetic resistance. Adjust intensity from the console or SunnyFit app, or follow 24 built-in programs that automatically change resistance for a more structured ride.
【FREE SUNNYFIT APP TRACKING & RESISTANCE CONTROL】 Connect to SunnyFit to sync your main ride data, including duration, calories, distance, speed, RPM, and resistance. Use the in-app interface to adjust resistance during your workout and review your progress after each session.
【OVERSIZED SEAT WITH 4-WAY ADJUSTMENT】 The wide padded comfort seat adjusts up, down, forward, and backward to help support your riding fit. Self-leveling pedals with adjustable straps help keep feet supported during forward or reverse pedaling.
【RESISTANCE BANDS FOR UPPER-BODY MOVEMENT WHILE YOU RIDE】Add more variety to seated cardio with the included resistance bands, designed for light upper-body movement while pedaling. Use them to engage your arms, shoulders, and upper body during your ride.
【300 LB CAPACITY WITH EASY SETUP & STORAGE】 Built to support users up to 300 lb, this smart upright bike includes floor levelers for a steady setup and front transport wheels for easy repositioning. Built-in tablet, bottle, and dumbbell storage help keep workout essentials close.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Power Rack
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Take your home gym to the next level with the Sunny Health & Fitness BH6802 Power Rack. The full functional power rack is designed with a small footprint in mind to tackle the big workouts of the day. Combine the Sunny Health and Fitness bars and bumper plates and perform workouts to target and strengthen muscles across your body. The powder-coating, durability, and utility are designed seamlessly into the power rack to fully support weight and powerlifting workouts. The compact Gym Rack lets you work out right in the comfort of your own home or garage. The result; a fully loaded power rack with features such as the included 360° swivel built-in landmine post, raised height to pull up bar, exercise band attachment points, durable J-hook and Spotter arms, as well as more than 30 adjustment points to fit people of all sizes. The squat rack is built with ample room to provide easy side-to-side movement. Now you can perform squats, curls, shrugs, pull-ups, push-ups, and more. you take away; a well-designed and small footprint rack that will help you build the Rome that is your body. We all know Rome wasn't built in a day, your body won't be either, but the Sunny Power Rack will help you get there one day at a time. Whether you're an experienced powerlifter/bodybuilder or someone just starting on their strength training journey, this power rack can keep up. Unleash your inner beast with the SF-BH6802 Power Rack by Sunny Health and Fitness. Hardware peg hole diameter: 1 in.
• HEAVY DUTY FRAME: Supports up to 880 lb Product Dims. (42 L X 47 W X 85H inches) Easy Assembly with bolt together design.
• VERSATILE: Included landmine barbell attachment for greater utility and usage during resistance training exercises like landmine squats, lunges, rows, and rotational exercises such as landmine standing anti rotations.
• KNURLING: Knurled Grip on Pull up Bar providing extra grip in strenuous/slippery workout sessions. Exercise band attachment points to better increase strength and endurance.

• OLYMPIC PLATE STORAGE: Easily organize weights on rack while adding extra stability when utilizing the machine. Freestanding design with optional bolts in brackets for stability and versatility.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness 6” Leather Lifting Belt - Small
fields.AU:
The Sunny Health & Fitness 6” Leather Lifting Belt is built for lifters who demand confidence under heavy loads, delivering uncompromising support, comfort, and durability. Designed for gym workouts including squats, deadlifts, Olympic lifting, and CrossFit training, it features premium split leather with reinforced double stitching for long-lasting performance. The wide 6-inch back support provides cushioned spinal stability for lifts up to 440 lb. Precision adjustment ensures a secure, personalized fit, available in sizes S–XXL to accommodate waist ranges from 22”–52”. Finished with a corrosion-resistant steel double-prong buckle, it locks you in with total control and is an essential for serious training at home or in the gym.
【HEAVY-DUTY SUPPORT UP TO 440 LB】 Engineered for serious strength training, this 6 inch leather lifting belt is rated to support loads up to 440 lb. Ideal for squats, deadlifts, Olympic lifting, and CrossFit workouts at home or in the gym.
【MAX COMFORT WIDE BACK SUPPORT】 A 6 inch wide back panel with 14 mm foam padding supports the lower back and spine without pinching or rib discomfort. Comfortable for long training sessions and high-volume workouts.
【PRECISION ADJUSTABLE FIT】 Multiple adjustment holes spaced 1 inch apart deliver a secure, dialed-in fit. Available in sizes S–XXL to accommodate waist sizes from 22”–52”, making it ideal for beginners and intermediate lifters as training intensity evolves.
【PREMIUM LEATHER + LONG-LASTING DURABILITY】 Made from thick, genuine split leather with an 8–9 mm front thickness, reinforced double stitching, and moisture- and odor-resistant treatment. Built to handle repeated heavy lifts with a shorter break-in period.
【SECURE STEEL DOUBLE-PRONG BUCKLE】 Heavy-duty, corrosion-resistant stainless steel double-prong buckle with plated brass buttons allows easy self-tightening and controlled release under tension. Offers greater adjustability and fewer failure points than lever or nylon belts.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Weightlifting Belt - Small
fields.AU:
The Sunny Health & Fitness 4” Nylon Weightlifting Belt is built for lifters who want flexible, reliable support during demanding training sessions. Designed to stabilize the core and lower back, it is ideal for squats, deadlifts, Olympic lifting, and resistance workouts, with trusted performance for lifters training in the 300–400 lb range. The comfort-focused 4” back panel with cushioned padding provides balanced support while allowing natural movement through dynamic and high-rep lifts.
Constructed from durable, breathable nylon with reinforced stitching, the belt helps resist moisture and odor while staying comfortable through long workouts. A quick-adjust hook & loop closure with reinforced webbing allows fast tightening and easy release between sets, even when training with sweat or chalk. Designed for men and women, it is available in sizes S–XXL to fit waist ranges from 24”–51.5”, making it a versatile and dependable choice for fast-paced training at home or in the gym.

fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
No two fitness journeys are the same; The Sunny Health & Fitness Electric Motorized Elliptical Trainer SF-E320001 allows you to progress and train at your own pace and the way you like. Target your upper body, lower body, or opt for a total body workout. Electro-magnetic resistance with fitness programs, upper body handlebars, and an advanced performance monitor gives you the necessary tools to focus and reach your goals.
• PERFORMANCE MONITOR: Stay informed and up to date on your fitness. The monitor displays: Speed, RPM, Time, Distance, Odometer, Calories, WATT, Heart Rate, Target Heart Rate, Program and Resistance Level.
• ELECTROMAGNETIC RESISTANCE: A change of pace is just a push of a button away with the electromagnetic resistance. Cycle through 16 progressive resistance levels to push your full body workouts to the limit!
• CUSTOMIZED FITNESS: Workout and train the way you like. 24 different elliptical training programs to suit and match your fitness goals.
• OPTIMAL STRIDE: 18 inches of stride length promotes exercise efficiency and low impact workouts. Get a total body workout that is friendly to your bones and joints.
• FLOOR STABILIZERS: Never have a wobbly or shaky elliptical workout again with the SF-E320001 Elliptical floor stabilizers.
• TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: Tilt and roll for use or away for easy storage with convenient transport wheels.
• DEVICE HOLDER: Place your tablet, phone, or other mobile devices to stay connected. Follow along online with our Sunny Health & Fitness trainers for certified fitness tips, advice, and lessons.
• FULL MOTION ARMS: Get a complete and total body workout using the upper body swing arms.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Portable Stand Up Elliptical with Resistance Bands - SF-E320051
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Get the type of workout that you’re looking for with the Sunny Health & Fitness Portable Stand Up Elliptical with Resistance Bands - SF-E320051. This space-saving cardio machine can be used while standing or sitting and with or without resistance bands. This under desk elliptical comes preassembled and requires minimal effort to finish the installation so you stride towards your fitness goals faster. Smooth and silent, you can look to squeeze in an exercise session just about anywhere and at any time.
• TOTAL BODY WORKOUT: Featuring padded-handled resistance bands, get a comprehensive workout that targets both your upper and lower body.
• DIGITAL MONITOR: Track your speed, time, distance, and calories burned on the digital monitor. The large numbers on the display make it easy to read while standing or sitting.
• COMPACT DESIGN: This space-saving machine (25.2L in x 16.5W in x 10.2H in) can easily be stored while not in use. Use the built-in carry handle to easily lift and move this elliptical machine (26.5lb).
• VERSATILE DESIGN: Achieve a cardiovascular workout standing up or sitting down. We designed this machine to help you develop muscles in your lower body and improve blood circulation through consistent exercise.
• WHISPER QUIET: This portable elliptical machine uses a durable belt-drive mechanism that keeps your strides smooth, quiet, and consistent in shared and compact spaces, including bedrooms and living rooms.
• MAGNETIC RESISTANCE: Control your workout intensity with the easy-to-use resistance dial. Cycle through 8 levels of magnetic resistance: Easy when you want it, and hard when you need it.
• OPTIMAL STABILITY: Feel confident standing or sitting with the 220 LB max user weight limit on the home-use cardio machine. The wide textured foot plates are designed to keep your feet steady and secure during your activity.
• BI-DIRECTIONAL PEDALING: Mix up your workout when your pedal backward and forward to test your balance, develop your lower body, and stimulate your neural muscular system in a brand-new way.

fields.AU:
Introducing the Sunny Health & Fitness Endurance Smart Elliptical Trainer, a top-notch home fitness machine. It offers low-impact, full-body workouts that protect knee and ankle joints while targeting multiple muscle groups.Enhance your fitness journey with the SunnyFit APP, featuring over 1000 workout videos and expert trainers for personalized guidance and real-time tracking.Experience quiet, smooth operation with 15 levels of magnetic resistance. This heavy-duty elliptical supports up to 300 lbs and is ideal for daily workouts, rehabilitation, or recovery. Adjustable features ensure comfort and effectiveness. 
Track your progress with the digital performance monitor, recording time, speed, distance, calories, and heart rate. Pulse sensors provide real-time heart rate feedback for safe, effective workouts.Enjoy hassle-free assembly with clear instructions and a comprehensive user manual. With over 20 years of excellence, Sunny Health & Fitness offers top-quality equipment and unmatched customer service. Elevate your fitness with the Endurance Smart Elliptical Trainer today! 

• 【LOW IMPACT ON FULL BODY】The pedal exerciser offers a low-impact, full-body workout that minimizes stress on joints with a smooth gliding motion. Our all-in-one elliptical promotes healthy levels of calorie, cardiovascular, and muscle toning.
• 【CONNECTED FITNESS】Connect this elliptical cross trainer via the FREE SunnyFit App and sync with your fitness goals, track, and personalize your workouts on the go. Explore 1,000+ workouts and 10,000+ workout routes from around the world.
• 【UNDISTURBED WORKOUT】Experience a low-noise workout with our elliptical, featuring a belt drive system & 15 levels of magnetic resistance. Enjoy quiet, smooth operation for focused exercise. Ideal for solo sessions and family fitness.
• 【QUALITY ASSURANCE】The heavy-duty elliptical supports up to 300LB, 11-inch stride length (use extended length), and adjustable step height (8.7-15.1”), it suits various body types. Enjoy comfortable and effective daily workout with durability and reliability.
• 【ENJOY THE STRIVING】Enjoy the ultimate comfort with adjustable foot pedals and customizable height. Achieve higher fitness goals with anti-slip pedals and floor stabilizers. Easily move and store it with built-in wheels, perfect for any space.
• 【TRACK YOUR PROGRESS】Track various metrics by comprehensive dashboard. View your time, speed, distance, calories, heart rate, target heart rate, and odometer on the digital performance monitor. Train at your perfect intensity level every workout!
• 【FOCUS ON EXERCISE】With a built-in bottle and device holder, stay hydrated and entertained at same time. User-friendly and intuitively designed, everything you need is at your fingertips. No plug is required, ensuring you a seamless start.
• 【WHY PULSE SENSORS?】Sunny Heart Rate Monitor HR200 offers real-time heart rate feedback, allowing precise workout adjustments and ensuring training within target zones and alerting if heart rate exceeds safe limits during intense exercise.
• 【HASSLE-FREE ASSEMBLY】Say goodbye to complicated setups with our straightforward instructions, including a user manual, adjustment guide, and video tutorial. Sunny customer service is ready to assist! Focusing on your fitness goals with right-away!
