fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Portable Stand Up Elliptical - SF-E3908
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Achieve a versatile cardiovascular workout in compact spaces with the SF-E3908 Portable Stand Up Elliptical. This space-saving cardio machine can be used while standing or sitting to promote muscle development in your lower body. Step on the wide, textured foot plates to maintain optimal stability while exercising. Perfect for bedrooms and shared spaces, this machine has a smooth belt-drive system that makes minimal noise. Challenge yourself with the 7-inch stride length and 8 levels of magnetic resistance. Use the built-in carry handle to easily store this in-home fitness machine.
• PRE-ASSEMBLED: This machine requires no assembly, so you can jump straight to your workout.
• COMPACT DESIGN: This space-saving machine (25.2L in x 18W in x 10.6H in) can easily be stored while not in use. Use the built-in carry handle to easily lift and move this elliptical machine (25.4lb).
• VERSATILE DESIGN: Achieve a cardiovascular workout standing up or sitting down. We designed this machine to help you develop muscles in your lower body and improve blood circulation through consistent exercise.
• WHISPER QUIET: This portable elliptical machine uses a durable belt-drive mechanism that keeps your strides smooth, quiet, and consistent in shared and compact spaces, including bedrooms and living rooms.
• MAGNETIC RESISTANCE: Control your workout intensity with the easy-to-use resistance dial. Cycle through 8 levels of magnetic resistance: Easy when you want it, and hard when you need it.
• OPTIMAL STABILITY: Feel confident standing or sitting with the 220 lb max user weight limit on the home-use cardio machine. The wide textured foot plates are designed to keep your feet steady and secure during your activity.
• DIGITAL MONITOR: Track your speed, time, distance, and calories burned on the digital monitor. The large numbers on the display make it easy to read while standing or sitting.
• BI-DIRECTIONAL PEDALING: Mix up your workout when your pedal backward and forward to test your balance, develop your lower body, and stimulate your neural muscular system in a brand-new way.

fields.AU:
Pack a cardio workout in the comfort of your own home with the SF-E3912 Pre-Programmed Elliptical Trainer by Sunny Health & Fitness. Stride 15.5inches when you step onto the wide and textured footplates. Grab onto the handlebars to engage muscles in your upper body and to maintain balance during your exercise. Hold onto the pulse grips to keep tabs on your heart rate as you stride. Maintain stability on any ground surface when you adjust the front and rear stabilizers on this elliptical cross trainer. Control workout resistance when you increase and decrease the 16 levels of programmable magnetic resistance when the elliptical is plugged into a power source (adapter included). Track your speed, time, distance, calories burned, rotations per minute, watt generation, heart rate, and computer-controlled resistance on one backlit LCD. Take advantage of 24 target-specific, pre-programed, and custom workout profiles. Use the recovery function to track how well your heart level returns to normal after you exercise. Activate the body-fat program to tailor elliptical workouts to your specific BMI. Designed for challenging workouts, this magnetic elliptical machine has a 330-pound weight capacity. Use the bottle holder to place your favorite hydrating beverage in arm's reach. After you workout, move this home-use elliptical trainer from room to room with ease by using the front-loaded transportation wheels.
• POWERFUL RESISTANCE: Challenge yourself with 16 levels of programmable magnetic resistance when you power on this elliptical machine. Complete smooth strides as you engage the internal, 13.2-pound flywheel and the belt-drive mechanism.
• PERFORMANCE MONITOR: Use the onboard, back-lit display to track your speed, time, distance, calories burned, rotations per minute, watt generations, and magnetic resistance level.
• WEIGHT CAPACITY: This machine is designed to be stable during challenging workouts. Take advantage of its 330 lbs weight capacity and its floor stabilizers, which will keep the elliptical steady.
• STABILITY: Step onto the wide and textured footplates to secure your footing as you stride. Hold onto the large handgrips for added stability and to engage your upper body during your exercise.
• TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: Move this elliptical from room to room with the front-loaded transportation wheels that can easily glide across ground surfaces.
• POWERFUL WORKOUTS: Take advantage of 24 unique workout modes, including manual, pre-program, watt, body fat, heart rate, and user programs.
• HEART RATE: Monitor your heart rate comfortably with the conveniently-located heart rate hand grips or an optional heart rate belt. Use heart rate info to start the recovery mode function after you complete a workout on this home-use elliptical.
• COMPACT STRIDE: The 15.5-inch stride on this magnetic elliptical helps conserve elliptical space and elevate your stride for greater stimulation of lower-body muscles, including calf muscles.

fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
The Sunny Health & Fitness Smart Electric Treadmill - SF-T722901 merges technology with user-focused design. A highlight is the SunnyFit® App Smart Fitness feature. Via the SunnyFit® App, users access trainer-led workouts tailored for both walking and running, complete with real-time feedback on workout metrics. Structurally, the treadmill boasts an innovative double running deck. It offers up to three adjustable incline levels to diversify training and enhance calorie burning. This ergonomic design is paired with a speed range of 0.5 to 9 mph, ensuring its adaptability to all fitness levels and goals. Prioritizing user comfort, the treadmill has a low-impact, shock-absorbing surface. This design emphasizes joint health, vital for training longevity and minimizing injuries. Space efficiency is at its core. Its easy installation process averages 20 minutes. Post-installation, the user-friendly interface becomes prominent. A spacious LED console displays real-time parameters such as calories, distance, and speed. Features like large buttons and handrail speed controls simplify operation. Moreover, the interface syncs with the SunnyFit app, echoing the brand's holistic fitness vision. In terms of robustness, it supports an impressive 275 LB weight, showcasing its durability. Users benefit from the live heart rate monitor with strategically placed sensors on the handrails. This data is accessible both on the treadmill and the SunnyFit app. For modern homes, its foldable design and transportation wheels enable easy storage and movement. The soft-drop system ensures user safety during storage. Rounding off, Sunny Health & Fitness, a fitness leader for over two decades, promises excellence. Their legacy assures users of the SF-T722901 a premium fitness experience.
• CONNECTED FITNESS- Bluetooth connectivity and get on track with expert-led workouts on SunnyFit® App. Choose from walking/running courses, access easily. See all workout stats right in the app.
• 3-LEVEL INCLINE & SUPERIOR STABILITY- Treadmill featuring 3 adjustable inclines for higher calorie burn. Enjoy stability and quality during runs, the double deck design provides structural support on its 16” surface.
• SPEED RANGE- Whether you're aiming for a gentle walk or a brisk run, this treadmill has you covered with a versatile speed range of 0.5 to 9 mph, catering to all fitness levels and workout intensities.
• LOW-IMPACT SHOCK ABSORBING- Enjoy running on a low-impact surface with the additionally padded double deck shock absorption technology. Protecting your joints will ensure the longevity of your training.
• EASY INSTALLATION- Designed with user convenience in mind, this treadmill can be easily set up in an average time of 20 minutes. Follow simple instructions to quickly assemble and start your fitness journey with no hassle.
• USER-FRIENDLY CONSOLE- The console shows Calories, Distance, Speed, Steps, Time. Track progress on SunnyFit app, connect with the community. User-centric design with spacious buttons, quick settings, handrail speed controls for ease.
• 275 LB WEIGHT CAPACITY- Heavy-duty treadmill built to withstand intense workouts. With a 275 LB weight capacity and sturdy construction, this machine provides unmatched stability for runners of all sizes.
• LIVE HEART RATE MONITOR- Monitor your workout in real-time with integrated pulse sensors in the handrails and SunnyFit App. Instant heart rate tracking keeps you updated on your performance and progress.
• EASY STORAGE & TRANSPORTATION WHEELS- The soft-drop system allows you to neatly tuck the treadmill away in any room. Transport it hassle-free using the tilt-and-roll feature - no heavy lifting required. Simply fold, grip the handlebars, tilt back, and roll the treadmill to your desired space.
• Sunny Health & Fitness Commitment- A top fitness brand for 20+ years, offers superior products and a dedication to excellence. Count on our committed customer service and trainers for the best fitness experience.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Upright Row-N-Ride® Exerciser in Silver - No. 077S
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Develop strength, speed, and leanness with the Sunny Health & Fitness No. 077S Home Squat Machine. Strengthen not only your lower body but your shoulders, arms, and back, this exerciser promotes compound movement (two or more muscle groups working cohesively). Activating groups of muscles together require more strength, so you'll burn more calories. Compound exercises bring compounded results! With 3 adjustable resistance bands, intensify your workout by adding or subtracting bands, each band adds approx. 22 pounds of resistance!
• WHY SQUAT: Squats are not only effective for building an insanely strong lower body, but also because they deliver a number of ancillary physical benefits, including increased hormone release and improved flexibility.
• HOW IT WORKS: Tone the lower body by using your glutes, quads, and hamstrings to push down to a squat. Work your shoulders, back, and chest as you push yourself up through every rep. Skip the weights, this squat trainer will reduce the amount of stress on the knees and joints that occurs when you squat incorrectly. Adding this to your workout will help you develop a proper form to get the perfect squat.
• TRACK YOUR FITNESS: The LCD monitor tracks your calories, scan, time, and count. This trainer gives you the freedom to add or remove tension, the three elastic bands can be clipped on or off the seat to adjust to any fitness level.
• WORKOUT VARIETY: Not only does it offer the ability to do a full-range squat but you can also add variety by doing high, median and low zone squats pulses.
• CONVENIENCE: Easily store almost anywhere in your home. Remove the knob, fold, and store; as easy as 1, 2, 3. Its self-leveling pedals help you to get in and out of the bike in a breeze. Stable end caps prevent any movement to ensure you have a stable and safe workout.
• ADJUSTABLE: Padded handle and saddle distance control adjust to your body length to develop the proper technique. Not only can you adjust the saddle proximity to the handlebar but it comes equipped with saddle angle control, which allows you to adjust the saddle at 30, 60, and 90 degrees giving you deeper squat positions.

fields.AU:
Presentation meets performance with the ASUNA 8570 Windmill Air Magnetic Rower. Maintain optimal stability on the fitted seat as you glide along the 49-inch aluminum slide rail. Place your feet onto the ergonomic footplates that feature heel pads and foot straps, which provide maximum balance, support, and force production. Engage the 14 lb flywheel as you pull against the progressive air resistance and the 10 levels of magnetic resistance. Track your duration, distance, stroke rate, wattage output, calories burned, and heart rate on the self-powered digital display. Intensify your workout with challenging preloaded workouts. The durable frame, which supports up to 330 lb, folds upright for easy storage. Achieve comfort, utility, and performance with the ASUNA 8570 Windmill Air Magnetic Rower.
• ERGONOMIC DESIGN: Comfort and performance start with utility. The tall sitting position of the air magnetic rower allows for easy mounting and dismounting. Maintain stability as you row on the fitted rower seat.
• DUAL RESISTANCE: Some things are better together. Use air and magnetic resistance simultaneously to intensify your workout on the exercise rower. The resistance created by the fan is progressive, which means the harder you work, the harder the fan works for you.
• POWERFUL DISPLAY: Use the digital meter to track your workout performance. Manage your duration, distance, strokes, wattage, calories burned, and heart rate on one screen. Mounted to a pivoting arm, the display has several viewing angles to fit your workout style.
• CHALLENGING WORKOUTS: Use the different modes to power your workout. The rower has two high-intensity workout modes and one custom high-intensity mode. Utilize the goal mode to set time-, distance-, and calorie-based trials. The display can also show speed as a water wave that visualizes your performance with force curves.
• WIRELESS CONTROLS: Experience convenience at its best. Easily adjust the 10 levels of magnetic resistance with wireless handlebar controls.
• ADJUSTABLE FOOTPADS: Secure foot placement is key to force production. The ASUNA 8570 is equipped with a two-way adjustable footplate. Utilize the sliding heel pads to secure your heel and midfoot as you drive the rower. Tighten the adjustable foot straps to prevent slippage while you stroke.
• SELF-GENERATING POWER: Enjoy a powerful display with none of the plugs. Enjoy the patented self-generating mechanism that powers the internal display with every stroke. The efficient display conserves power after 10 seconds of inactivity.

fields.AU:
Discover new ways to challenge yourself with the ASUNA 8580 Ventus Air Magnetic Rower. Produce powerful strokes along the 50-inch aluminum slide rail while seated on the ergonomic seat pad. Strap your feet onto the adjustable footplates that sport sliding heel pads, which can accommodate any shoe size. Engage the smooth belt-drive system to pull against dynamic air resistance and the 12 levels of magnetic tension. The performance display tracks time, distance, stroke rate, wattage output, calories burned, heart rate, and real-time exercise data. Intensify your exercise routine with 3 preloaded workout modes. Fold the aluminum slide rail upright for easy storage. Use the transportation wheels to transport this machine from room to room. This rower supports up to 330 lb. Maximize your rowing potential with the ASUNA 8580 Windmill Air Magnetic Rower.
• ERGONOMIC DESIGN: The ergonomic seat pad sits 16 inches off the ground, which makes it easier to get on and off of the commercial rower. Use the fitted seat to maintain stability and comfort as you row.
• DUAL RESISTANCE: Pull against both air and magnetic resistance to intensify your workout. The air resistance created by the fan is progressive, which means the harder you work, the harder the fan works for you. The belt drive and resistance mechanisms are virtually maintenance-free.
• POWERFUL DISPLAY: Visualize your workout performance with the large digital meter. Manage your duration, distance, strokes, wattage, calories burned, and heart rate on one screen. Pivot the eye-level workout display 160° for maximum visibility.
• TRACK WORKOUT ESSENTIALS: Conveniently monitor your total strokes, average watt and stroke count, and resistance level with the digital display. View your overall race performance in real-time with the dynamic chart. Calculate race time and distance in 500-meter splits.
• 3 CHALLENGING WORKOUT MODES: Target your workout performance in manual mode. Jump into training mode to set speed-related goals. Use the race mode to challenge yourself against a computer while tracking your progress on screen.
• WIRELESS CONNECTIVITY: Connect a wireless ANT-compatible heart rate sensor to monitor your pulse in real time on the performance display.
• ADJUSTABLE FOOTPADS: Utilize the adjustable footplate for an optimal workout experience. Slide your foot onto the adjustable heel pads to secure your heel and midfoot as you drive on the rower. The footpad can accommodate any shoe size.

fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Elevate your practice with the Sunny Health & Fitness High-Density Yoga Mat—a studio-quality foundation designed for yogis who value balance, control, and a grounded feel. Unlike thick, overly cushioned mats that can cause instability or a “sinking” sensation in standing poses, this 4mm (0.16") slim-profile mat keeps you closely connected to the floor for improved alignment and confidence. Crafted from professional-grade, tear-resistant PVC, it’s built to withstand daily use without stretching or peeling. The textured surface supports steady positioning across hardwood, tile, or carpet, while the lightweight, closed-cell construction resists moisture and wipes clean easily. Whether you’re practicing Vinyasa, Pilates, or meditation, this mat delivers the ideal balance of joint protection and floor connection—at home, in the studio, or on the go.
【STUDIO-QUALITY DURABILITY】Built for daily practice, this high-density PVC yoga mat resists wear, stretching, and flaking. Like premium studio mats, this dense material is designed to last, so you can move with confidence class after class after class.
【TEXTURED SURFACE FOR CONTROLLED MOVEMENT】 Feel secure and connected throughout your practice. The textured surface supports controlled movement and steady positioning during stretches and flows. The closed-cell PVC design resists moisture absorption and wipes clean easily after every session.
【GROUNDED FEEL FOR BETTER BALANCE】 Measuring 68" L x 24" W with a slim 4mm (0.16") profile, this is the ideal travel yoga mat. Many experienced yogis prefer thinner mats because they keep you closer to the floor, promoting stability, balance, and confident alignment in standing and balancing poses.
【FIRM SUPPORT & JOINT PROTECTION】 Thick, overly cushioned mats can compress under weight and affect balance. This high-density foam delivers firm, responsive support—providing a protective barrier for knees and wrists on hard floors while maintaining a stable foundation.
【VERSATILE FOR YOGA & PILATES】 Perfect for yoga, Pilates, meditation, and daily stretching. This lightweight mat rolls up easily so you can take it from your home gym to your favorite studio or a backyard workout.
【FREE ACCESS TO SUNNYFIT APP】  Enhance your wellness journey with the SunnyFit App. Enjoy complimentary access to expert-led yoga flows, guided workouts, and personalized fitness programs—absolutely no subscription required.
【EST. IN SUNNY CALIFORNIA SINCE 2002】 Sunny Health & Fitness delivers premium equipment with a commitment to quality. Backed by U.S.-based support and certified trainers, we offer a truly unmatched “Fit for Everyone” experience.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Tri-Fold Exercise Mat - NO. 048
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
If you've ever stretched or exercised on a hardwood floor, you know just how uncomfortable it can be when sitting, kneeling, or trying yoga and Pilates exercises. Whether you're at home, the gym, or the beautiful outdoors, don't let the hard ground stand in the way of your fitness routine. The Sunny Health & Fitness No. 048 Tri-Fold Exercise Mat will help keep you fit and flexible, making various forms of training possible to do anywhere, anytime!
• TRIFOLD MAT: This exercise mat helps ensure that exercises, such as stomach crunches and leg extensions, are carried out on adequate cushioning for the back, particularly the spinal cord. This design ensures that your movements’ momentum isn't lost while still providing substantial shock protection. At 6-feet in length (72L x 24W), it allows most users to lie down comfortably while doing abs workout, planks, and long duration yoga poses.
• LIGHTWEIGHT & PORTABLE: Integrated two-carrying nylon handles make transportation convenient, and the tri-fold design is compact to fit easily into closets, car trunks, or storage units at the gym.
• COMFORTABLE PADDING: Features 2-inch padding for extra comfort and support during a variety of training exercises, ideal for activities and exercises such as yoga, core strengthening, stretching, Pilates, and martial arts.
• VERSATILE: Ideal for all skill levels, beginners to advanced, and exercising at home or in the gym with the team. This is also perfect as a spare bed, or as a floor mat, yoga, Pilates or exercise mat, futon mattress, or for a children's play area.
• CONVENIENT NYLON STRAPS – Grip the slip-resistant bands to carry your yoga mat on the go! No need to struggle with carrying the entire mat in your arms.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Vinyl Coated Kettle Bell - 15Lbs
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Develop power, endurance, and balance with Sunny Health & Fitness No. 066 Vinyl Coated Kettlebell. Increase the intensity of your workout with these high-quality kettlebells that will sculpt and tone the entire body. Lifting and controlling forces the muscle targeting in the core, arms, and back while building strength and stability. Made out of high-grade cast-iron material, it is great for training indoors and outdoors. Whether you work out at home or at your home gym, take them wherever you go. The Sunny Health Fitness Vinyl-covered Kettlebell is the ideal choice for those seeking a special edge in strength and power.
• HIGH-QUALITY VINYL COAT FINISH: Durable cast iron encased with color-coded vinyl prevents corrosion, increases durability, and protects flooring. Featured in multiple weights varying from 5 to 25 lb.
• WIDE HANDLES: Smooth, high-quality textured handle provides a comfortable & secure grip for high reps and slow controlled movements. you can also do a multitude of ballistic and grind exercises.
• FLAT BOTTOM: Flat base allows upright storage. It also makes it easier to hold in the push-up position, renegade rows, mounted pistol squats & other exercises requiring a kettlebell with a flat bottom.
• FOR ALL FITNESS ENTHUSIASTS: Kettlebells can be used by cross-fitters, strength trainers, sports performance, HIIT workouts, etc. Build up your cardio and muscular endurance with the all-in-one fitness equipment. Used for swings, deadlifts, squats.
• ERGONOMIC: Compact kettlebell size allows you to take your weights to the park, gym, or on the go. Use these cannonball-shaped workout tools to get a leaner and tighter figure.

fields.AU:
Combine high-quality performance and superior folding capabilities with the SF-T7718 Strider Treadmill with 20” Wide LoPro Deck by Sunny Health and Fitness. Run with confidence on the extra-wide running treadmill designed with comfort, stability, and a low-profile deck. Unlike traditional elevated treadmills, the strider treadmill surface is close to the ground to mimic an outdoor running experience while the shock absorption protects your joints. Lower center of gravity supports greater stability giving you more assurance to run at greater speeds from 0.6 to 9 MPH with 9 built-in programs. The sleek design and compact construction are great for smaller in-home gyms. Walk with the treadmill machine that will fit in your place, at your pace!

• LOW PROFILE CONSTRUCTION: Unlike traditional treadmills that are elevated, bulky, and require more space, this treadmill is compact, sleek, and designed lower to the floor so you can maintain balance and confidence to run at higher speeds. This unique feature is designed to help you center Experience unparalleled comfort and stability on the running deck designed closer to the ground. Running deck measures at 47L x 20W (inches)
• SAFETY & COMFORT: High-density rubber handrails are slip resistant and provide additional support as you continue a steady pace. The home treadmill is installed with shock absorption that surrounds the bottom deck of the treadmill. • PRE-ASSEMBLED: Treadmill arrives intact and fully assembled. Simply unbox your running machine, unfold the treadmill deck from the console and begin your workout. Convenient pre-assembly means you can save time, money, and energy on putting together your treadmill.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Energy Flex Motorized Treadmill
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Change the way you build your cardiovascular fitness with the Sunny Health & Fitness SF-T7724 Energy Flex Motorized Treadmill. Run-on the space-saving running deck (51.5L x 18W inches) that is equipped with a responsive shock absorption system. The cushioned belt on the flex treadmill absorbs impact on each step, which can reduce stress on your lower-body joints as you exercise. Designed for both walking and running, this indoor treadmill can achieve speeds between 0.6mph and 10 mph. Control your workout intensity with 15 levels of automatic recline. Track your cardiovascular performance with the built-in pulse sensor grips. Use the back-lit, color performance monitor to track your speed, time, distance, calories burned, pulse, and recline level. Customize your workout experience with 3 countdown workouts, 3 user-customized workouts, a BMI calculator, and 16 preset programs. Enjoy convenient quick buttons that control speed and recline. Make detailed adjustments to your speed and recline using the handlebar controls. Place your smartphone or tablet in the device holder and charge your device via the onboard USB port. Play your music through the recline treadmill speakers through the included AUX cable. Use the Bluetooth function to play music wirelessly and answer and decline phone calls. Easily take breaks when you place your hydrating beverages in the bottle holders. Enjoy a comfortable and enduring running experience with the 240 lb weight capacity. After you workout, lift the folding treadmill upright to save space. The cardio machine is equipped with a soft-drop mechanism to prevent the running deck from crashing to the floor. Move the running treadmill from room to room with the easy-to-use transportation wheels.
• MADE FOR RUNNING: Dash up to 10 mph with comfort as your feet strike the cushioned, shock absorption-equipped running deck. The soft and responsive running belt (51.5L x 18W inches) absorbs impact on each step, which can reduce stress on your joints while you exercise.
• AUTOMATIC recline: Instantly increase workout intensity when you adjust the automatic recline. Boost recline from 0 to 15 levels with the quick buttons on the home-use treadmills.
• PULSE SENSORS: Be aware of your heart rate while you exercise with the conveniently located pulse grips. Grab onto them for near-instant feedback on the intensity of your workout.
• PERFORMANCE MONITOR: Track important workout data including your speed, distance, time, calories burned, pulse, and recline on the backlit, color display.
• CUSTOM PROGRAMS: Mix up your workout with 16 preset workouts, 3 user-customized workouts, and 3 countdown workouts. The cardio machine is also equipped with a BMI calculator.
• TABLET HOLDER: Add multimedia entertainment to your workout experience when you place a personal device on the integrated tablet holder. Charge your device with the onboard USB port, and play your favorite music through the included AUX cable.
• BLUETOOTH CAPABILITY: Play your music wirelessly through Bluetooth via the onboard speakers. Answer and deny phone calls when you work out using the on-console buttons. And hold phone conversations on the treadmill with the built-in microphone.
• TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: After you work out, use the transportation wheels to easily push the portable treadmill across your home for easy storage.

Engage muscles in your entire body with the No. 079 Hexagon Trampoline with Adjustable Handlebar by Sunny Health and Fitness. The mini trampoline features 6 sturdy pegs for safety and stability. • DURABLE FRAME: Ideal for men and women alike, this trampoline trainer has a compact design that allows it to fit in small spaces. Max weight capacity supports 220 pounds. Clean with a damp towel to remove any sweat or debris after a great workout.

• CARDIOVASCULAR BENEFITS: Rebounding is an excellent low-impact workout that helps improve your cardiovascular system. Benefits of trampoline exercise include a full-body workout while firming legs, thighs, abdomen, and hips.

fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Improve your functional fitness and enhance your performance with the Sunny Health & Fitness Pilates Bands. With three different degrees of variable resistance ranging from 10 to 30 pounds, the Sunny Health & Fitness Pilates Bands are an important addition to all fitness levels looking for a low-cost portable workout option. The bands allow you to perform a wide variety of exercises that can target most major muscles of the body. Each latex band enables you to focus your preferred resistance specifically on different parts of the body, while also allowing for fluid joint motion. When utilized under the guidance of a licensed physical therapist, these bands can also provide rehabilitation assistance. Whether your goal is to gain muscular strength, increase flexibility, build muscular endurance, or tone your muscles the Sunny Health & Fitness Pilates Bands can help much like a Pilates reformer. Create your own great workout

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Hydro+ Dual Resistance Magnetic Water Rowing Machine - SF-RW5809
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
The Sunny Health & Fitness Dual Resistance Magnetic Water Rowing Machine is designed to turn your living room into your personalized regatta. Using water as a form of resistance, the 16 water blades deliver the intensity of rowing in a lake and emulates the smooth and natural feeling of rowing in the open water. With Magnetic resistance, you can add more resistance to a dynamic and challenging workout. It packs features to make your workout more comfortable and your sessions more productive. An advanced digital monitor includes metrics that let you accurately measure and then help you achieve your fitness goal!
• DYNAMIC RESISTANCE: The water resistance adapts to your style of rowing and your intensity. The faster and harder you row, the more resistance is generated. 
• SUPPLEMENTAL RESISTANCE: 16 levels of magnetic resistance adds a new layer and dimension to your workouts. This combination of magnetic and water resistance produces a unique rowing experience that will push your performance to the next level.
• STEEP ANGLE: The water tank is angled at 60 degrees for the water blades to dig deeper and emulate the experience and feel of rowing in the water.
• DIGITAL MONITOR: Features a swivel design and tracking of: Time, Time/500M, SPM, Distance, Strokes, Total Strokes, Calories Burned, and Pulse. It also includes a Racing function.
• SEATING HEIGHT: Sitting at 15.5 inches off the floor, a higher seat allows for an easier and more convenient method to mount and dismount the rowing machine
• DEVICE HOLDER: Place your mobile device and follow along to your favorite Sunny Health & Fitness training videos.
• FULL RANGE: Sitting 12 inches in front of the foot pedals, the padded handlebar is positioned to provide you with a full range of motions during your strokes.
• HEART RATE SENSOR: Capable of syncing with ANT+ connected devices. you can wirelessly measure your pulse through the digital monitor. Wireless heart rate monitor not included.
• TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: Moving your water rower could not be easier. Simply lift, tilt, and roll away for storage or into another room. 
• SPACE SAVER: Stands vertically to save space and to simplify storage.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Programmable Magnetic Rower
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Engage in a low-impact cardio routine with the Programmable Magnetic Rower by Sunny Health and Fitness. Plug the rower into an outlet to power the magnetic resistance. Condition muscles in the back, shoulder, and core as you pull against the 11-pound flywheel. Modify intensity by adjusting the 16 levels of magnetic resistance. Swivel the workout meter on the indoor rowing machine to get the best view of your workout data. Use the digital meter to track workout duration, rowing strokes, and calories burned. Enjoy an optimized workout with the fitness rower’s program mode that has 7 workout presets, 4 user-customizable presets, 2 challenge modes, and one recovery mode. Use an ANT-compatible heart belt (not included) to track heart rate during workouts on the rower. Push back silently on the rowing machine as you glide along the 46.5-inch aluminum railing. The durable (92L x 20.5W x 32H) rower frame supports a maximum user weight of 300 lb. Save space when the magnetic rowing machine is not in use by folding the aluminum rail upright (43L x 20.5W x 60.5H Folded Dimensions).
• SILENT GLIDE: Avoid sliding noises with the aluminum slide rail. The soft touch metal on the fitness equipment allows for a quiet slide as you produce powerful rowing strokes. The aluminum build is rust resistant and lightweight. It can also support up to 300 lb.
• MOVABLE LCD: Never worry about batteries when using the adapter-powered rower. Pivot your workout meter up and down to get the best view of your data while you're working out on the exercise rower.
• COMPETITION MODE: The digital meter has two workout modes that will challenge you during your exercise routine. Activate the competition program to begin a rowing time trial. Race against the time marks to complete as many strokes as possible.
• MONITOR HEART RATE: Start the pulse program that adjusts the magnetic resistance on the fitness machine based on your pulse reading from an ANT-compatible heart rate belt (sold separately). Use the recovery mode with a wireless heart rate belt to track how well your heart rate recovers after your workout.
• EASY STORAGE: This exercise rower is designed to be stored in tight spaces. The aluminum rail folds upright, which allows the rower to be stored easily (43L x 20.5W x 60.5H). Move the rower around your home using the front-mounted transportation wheels.
• ADJUSTABLE MAGNETIC RESISTANCE: Control how you condition the muscles in your back and shoulders with 16 levels of magnetic resistance. Power the rower to activate the magnetic resistance mechanism that intensifies your workout by adding magnetic force against the 11-pound flywheel.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Carbon Premium Air Magnetic Rowing Machine - SF-RW5983
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Hold on tight to the handlebar because your workouts will surely be blown away by the Sunny Health & Fitness Premium Carbon Air Magnetic Rowing Machine SF-RW5983! Features a dual Air and magnetic resistance system which works synergistically towards an intense total body workout. Improve your overall stamina or focus on powerful strokes, the Carbon rower has countless ways to customize your home workouts to fit your goals.
• SWIVELING DIGITAL MONITOR: Stay on top of your goals with an advanced digital monitor. Plug into a standard 120v/60hz outlet to power the display and track you: Time, Pulse, Calories Burned, Distance, Strokes Per Minute (SPM) & Total Strokes.
• WIRELESS PULSE RECEIVER: Included with your Carbon Premium Air Magnetic Rowing Machine is a wireless pulse receiver to accurately measure your heart rate. Receive real-time updates on your fitness metrics and adjust your workouts on the fly.
• DUAL RESISTANCE SYSTEM: The resistance on this premium air rower is complemented with magnets to provide an enhanced and unique rowing experience.
• METALLIC FAN BLADES: The Carbon Rowing Machine incorporates rigid Metallic fan blades that reduces flex and bend when rowing compared with the more commonly used plastic fan blades of other air rowers. This improves the integrity and consistency of the air resistance with every stroke.
• DUAL SLIDE RAIL: Stainless steel slide rail provides smooth and quiet operation; Perfect for home use and the sleek portable designed exercise machine is a perfect fit for those looking to be space-efficient.
• DEVICE HOLDER: Catch, Drive, Finish and Recover. Stay focused on your technique and your workouts using your tablet or mobile device to follow along with your favorite training videos.
• 22 preset PROGRAMS: Row through 22 different manual and preset rowing programs targeting you: Body Fat, WATTs, Heart Rate, and more.
• MULTI-USER PROFILES: Track and log up to 4 user profiles to switch up your fitness modes or share among different members of your household.
• ELEVATED SEAT HEIGHT: The height of the seat rises 16.5 inches off the floor to provide easy access to mount/dismount from the Carbon Rowing Machine

fields.F: ASUNA 4500 Commercial Folding Rowing Machine Rower w/ Heart Rate Monitor
fields.N: 5 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Combine premium commercial quality and the comfort and privacy of your home with the ASUNA 4500 Rowing Machine! Made of commercial-grade steel and aluminum, this rower is fit for use in any gym or fitness studio but has been made available for fitness enthusiasts' personal use. With its transportation wheels and foldability, the ASUNA 4500 can be easily moved and stored between workouts, making the transformation of your living space into a fitness studio a breeze! Featuring electronic tension controls, a programmable magnetic resistance system, and a large LCD monitor that displays your time, speed, distance, calories burned, watts, and pulse, this machine is fully equipped with the latest in exercise technology. Any user's fitness level is accounted for with ASUNA 4500's 12 different programmable modes, making this rower ideal for all at-home workouts. Its heart rate sensor belt and built-in wireless pulse receiver keep your safety and health at the forefront of your at-home fitness regimen!
• 12 Built-in Programs: Manual workout, 6 Preset Programs, Target Heart Rate and 4 User Set programs.
• Drum magnetic control system (DMC) and Electronic tension control allows for various tension levels.
• Built in wireless pulse receiver; includes chest strap to monitor heart rate
• Large LCD displays Time, Count, Calories, Distance, Strokes/min, Watt, and Pulse
• Built in transportation wheels for easy portability, and Foldable; 300 LBS user weight capacity

fields.AU:
Train like a champion with the No. 067 Black Kettlebell by Sunny Health and Fitness. The athlete-approved Sunny Health and Fitness Kettlebells are built to endure even the toughest workouts. Recently featured at the Legion of Beast CrossFit games, the high-grade cast iron workout bells maintained form without even a crack. These high-quality solid kettlebells are constructed of solid cast iron with no welds, weak spots, or seams. The diameter of the handle is crafted for your hand and body to have more control and stability while performing snatches, squats, and strength training exercises. Feel secure as you grip the smooth kettlebell for easy lifting. The black iron kettlebell is available in 30 lb, 40 lb, 50 lb, 60 lb, 70 lb, 80 lb, and 90 lb. Easily use both hands to grip the outsides of the kettlebells while performing lunges, squats, or other resistance training exercises. The coating protects from corrosion or cracking and is durable enough to withstand repetitive motions! Become Stronger. Become Greater. Become Better; with the Black Kettlebell by Sunny Health and Fitness.

• MULTI-WEIGHT OPTIONS: The black iron kettlebell is available in 30 LBs, 40 LBS, 50 Lbs, 60 Lbs, 70 Lbs, 80LBs, and 90LBs. Multi-weight fitness kettlebells are great for males or females and beginner to advanced fitness enthusiasts.
• ATHLETE APPROVED: Improve endurance with kettlebell swings, deadlifts, snatches, and squats. Excellent strength, cardio, and resistance training tools for competitions. Featured at LOB CrossFit Games.

fields.AU:
The Sunny Health & Fitness 40 lb Vinyl Dumbbell Set is designed to provide versatility to your workouts so you can enhance your physical strength, power, muscular growth, and muscular endurance. Our fitness weights feature a solid textured grip. The handle design features a curved center that contours to the natural arch of your hand giving the user a secure but not overly aggressive feel for a truly exceptional workout experience. The solid steel polypropylene coated bars are 17 inches long to provide ample space to accommodate the 6 interchangeable vinyl plates. The mid-point of the Handlebar measures 1.1 inches in diameter. This set includes (4) 1.5 lb weights, (4) 2.5 lb weights, and (4) 5 lb weights totaling 40 pounds when fully assembled. Polypropylene locking collar stars (0.2 lb each) tighten to hold the plates in place even during intense movements. Add or remove the smooth incremental plates to target muscles in your arms, shoulders, chest, back, legs, and core while preventing damage to floors and surfaces compared to cast iron counterparts. Eliminate the need for a large rack in your in-home workout area as you easily assemble different weight amounts to use during full body toning workouts.
• 40 POUNDS: Each set comes equipped with a pair of dumbbells with enough weight to create 2 dumbbells weighing 5 pounds, 10 pounds, or 20 pounds.

fields.AU:
Combine premium commercial quality and the comfort and privacy of your home with the ASUNA 4200 Upright Bike! Made of commercial-grade steel, this bike is fit for use in any gym or fitness studio but has been made available for fitness enthusiasts' personal use. With its transportation wheels, the ASUNA 4200 can be easily moved between workouts, making the transformation of your living space into a fitness studio a breeze! Featuring an LCD monitor that displays your time, speed, distance, calories burned, watts, and pulse, this bike is fully equipped with the latest in exercise technology. Any rider's fitness level is accounted for with ASUNA 4200's 5 different modes and electronic tension control, making this bike ideal for all at-home cyclists. Adjustable pedal straps and display functions that track both pulse recovery and BMI keep your safety and health at the forefront of your biking regimen!

• Large LCD displays Time, Speed, Distance, Calories, Watt, and Pulse
• Adjustable seat and pedal straps for maximum comfort; 265 LBS user weight capacity

• Built-in transportation wheels for easy portability
• Sturdy steel frame with an integrated bottle holder

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Cross Training Magnetic Recumbent Bike
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Achieve a full-body workout and burn more calories with Cross Training Magnetic Recumbent Bike. The moveable handlebars transform this recumbent bike into the ultimate low-impact home fitness machine. handlebars move back and forth while pedaling involving, the arms, back, and shoulders, this will increase the amount of effort during the entire movement resulting in increased calorie expenditure. The magnetic tension system allows users to quickly adjust the tension up or down to increase the effectiveness of the workout. The belt drive mechanism makes the bike virtually silent during the pedal stroke for a smoother ride. Self Leveling pedals make placing feet in and out effortless. The digital monitor displays all the basic workout functions: Speed, Time, Distance, Calories, and Total Distance. The enhanced workout functions of the monitor include Multifunction Countdown Timer (Countdown: Time, Distance, and Calories). A convenient alarm will sound indicating the chosen countdown is completed. Workout intensity can be measured with the integrated pulse sensors, which accurately display heart rate (BPM). The oversized cushioned seat and back will keep the user comfortable during your workouts, and decrease the amount of pressure on the knees and hips. The seat can be adjusted quickly while still seated to find the perfect distance to the pedals. The maximum weight capacity of 350 pounds can accommodate many users. Transportation wheels make moving simple and convenient.
• MOVEABLE HANDLEBARS— Includes the arm movement s to work synchronously with the legs during the pedal stroke to achieve a full-body workout
• LOWER BODY: Isolate your arm workouts by placing your feet firmly on the floor. Crank up the 8 adjustable gears and feel the higher resistance and intensity as you burn calories and achieve a killer arm workout.
• PULSE SENSORS—Integrated pulse sensors to read heart beats per minute
• 8 LEVELS OF RESISTANCE—magnetic resistance systems allows users from all different fitness levels to achieve a challenging effective work-out.
• OVERSIZED SEAT AND BACK—The large seat supports the hips and seat back to ensure correct posture and increase comfort during the workout
• SELF LEVELING FOOT PEDALS—The non-slip adjustable foot pedals have a large surface area to push hard and keep users' feet stable during the entire pedal stroke. The adjustable straps keep users feet secure and avoid sliding forward or to the side
• EASY ADJUSTABLE SEAT— Seat will move while still seated to find the optimal distance to the pedals and Handlebars
• DIGITAL DISPLAY MONITOR— Basic functions: SPEED, TIMER, DISTANCE, CALORIES, TOTAL DISTANCE, PULSE/ Enhanced functions: SCAN MODE, AUTO STOP/START, ALARM for custom countdowns. Scan mode allows the user to see multiple functions during the workout.
• BELT DRIVE—Enables a virtually silent and smooth ride while pedaling
• EXTENDED WEIGHT CAPACITY—The sturdy heavy duty frame can accommodate weights up to 350 lbs.

fields.AU:
Cycle inCycle into fitness with the SF-RB4850 Programmable Recumbent Bike by Sunny Health & Fitness. Slide your feet onto the universal pedals that have textured grips and universal straps for optimal stability. Sit comfortably on the wide recumbent bike seat, equipped with breathable mesh back support. Use the easy-to-use seat adjustment lever to modify your distance from the pedals (leg inseam 23.6 inches to 33.1 inches). Take advantage of the step-through design to easily mount and dismount the cardio machine. Made for enduring workouts, the cardio stationary bike has a 300 lb user weight capacity. Grab the seat-level pulse grips to check your heart rate while exercising. This recumbent bike has 16 levels of automatic magnetic tension, which can be controlled through the console. Enjoy a smooth and quiet exercise experience, powered by a virtually maintenance-free belt-drive mechanism. Perform 13-inch strides that are easy on the joints when you rotate the 6.6-pound flywheel pedal while providing you with an alternative cardiovascular workout. Use the color meter display to track your time, speed, rotation per minute, distance, calories burned, pulse, and wattage. Take advantage of 24 built-in workouts that are designed for various fitness levels, built-in BMI calculator software, and additional target heart rate and wattage programs. Place your phone or tablet onto the device holder. Use the water bottle holder to keep your favorite drink in arm’s reach. Maintain stability when your exercise by adjusting the ground levelers. Designed for easy moving, use the lift handle on the rear of the recumbent stationary bike to move the bike from room to room by using the onboard transportation wheels.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Electromagnetic Mini Exercise Bike - SF-B020029
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Looking to put in a workout while you work from home? Need something to keep your body moving while rehabilitating? The easily transportable and fully assembled SF-B020029 Electric Under Desk Bike by Sunny Health & Fitness is a perfect product for your sedentary needs. This space-saving exercise machine can help get your legs moving in a forward motion. Large textured foot pedals with adjustable straps prevent your feet from slipping while riding. This motorized under-the-desk bike is excellent for increasing blood circulation, joint range of motion, and improved lower body muscular endurance. Use the digital panel to select 18-levels of electric resistance that will provide a wide variety of exercise intensities to fit your needs. Use the digital monitor to track speed, time, calories, and distance. The experience when using this product is smooth, quiet, and simple while offering a steady ride with floor stabilizers for even placement. (automatic stop feature) Automatic safety stop feature.
• DIGITAL MONITOR: The large LCD console displays time, count, calories, and total count allowing you to stay on top of your fitness goals and progress. The convenient scan mode functions by rotating between all the metrics while you keep pedaling.
• ADJUSTABLE ELECTROMAGNETIC RESISTANCE: 18-levels of magnetic resistance gives you full control over how much load to add or remove, so you can switch up your workouts on demand. Use the buttons on the main panel to set your preferred resistance level or with the included remote.
• DUAL FUNCTION: Pedal with your feet or your hands. Easily accomplish a full body workout, it's fun, simple, and effective.
• EFFICIENCY: The 7-inch stride enables for much more efficient workouts than other mini exercise bikes with shorter lengths.
• SLIP RESISTANT: Rubberized suction cups located beneath the stabilizers provides an anti-slip feature, so you can stay safe and stay focused on your workouts.
• CARRY HANDLE: The carry handle allows for quick and easy portability. Lift it and carry around with you wherever you want to workout. You can even lift it onto your desk for a quick upper body hand pedaling session around your home or office.
• NON-SLIP PEDALS: Textured non-slip foot pedals will ensure safe footing during the most demanding and vigorous workouts. Foot straps keep your feet saddled with so you can focus on the workout without feeling unbalanced.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Tornado LX Air Bike
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Train like a champion with unlimited resistance on the SF-B2729 LX TORNADO Air Bike by Sunny Health and Fitness. The newest Tornado Air Bike is BIGGER, STURDIER, and MORE Durable for the toughest workout. Dimensions: 55L x 23.5W x 49H inches. The greater your speed and force the more resistance this fan bike can make! The commercial-grade oversized 27.5-inch fan wheel drives unlimited air resistance as you pedal forward with heavy momentum. The stylish red paddles are enclosed in an upgraded fan cover guard to protect accidental dirt and debris from damaging the fan. Ergonomic extreme grip handlebars are designed to increase muscle engagement in the arms, back, shoulders during the push and pull action. This upright bike is packed full of incredible features. The large multi-function screen displays your fitness metrics simultaneously as you pedaling hard on the fan bike. Receive advanced details on power output (WATT) and cadence (RPM) to determine and gauge workout intensities. The console is BLUETOOTH compatible to receive accurate real-time heart rate readings (Bluetooth heart rate strap not included). Quick Access button features make programming your target goals EASY: Target Time, Target Distance, Target Calories, and Target Heart Rate. Simple preset interval timers are integrated and can be started with one press of the button. Customize your workout intervals with the Custom Interval feature. The heavy-duty steel frame holds an incredible 330 lb which maximizes stability during vigorous rides. Large non-slip foot pedals will keep your feet secure during slow or rapid pedal strokes. Oversized footpegs allow you to place your feet on them to eliminate the pedaling action, and to emphasize the upper body. (Inseam: Min 28 / Max 41 inches) Get the right fit with the 4-way adjustable seat to ensure your posture and body mechanics are in the optimal position. Easily transport your bike with the large transportation wheels that will glide easily across carpet or a flat surface. The ultra-durable handlebar on the back of the bike allows you to lift and maneuver your bike effortlessly. Cross the finish line with new goals and better stamina with the SF-B2729 TORNADO Air Bike by Sunny Health and Fitness.
• HIGHER WEIGHT CAPACITY - The heavy-duty steel frame now holds up to an incredible 330 lb to maximize stability during vigorous rides.
• UPGRADED CRANK SYSTEM – Don't be afraid to put your foot down and go all out on this bike. The upgraded steel crank is built to withstand time and go the distance with users of all sizes and levels!
• HUGE 27.5” INCH FAN —Creates more air resistance resulting in an incredibly effective workout. The new front fan cover guard protects the steel cage encasing the stylish red paddles, so you Don't have to worry about damages during transport
• NEW TRANSPORTATION HANDLEBAR – Designed for convenience and easy mobility. The ultra-durable handlebar on the back of the bike allows you to lift and maneuver your bike effortlessly.
• BIGGER TRANSPORTATION WHEELS – Easily transport the bike across any surface with the new, sturdy, rubberized wheels. These non-marking wheels make moving in and out easy and convenient.
• TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: After your workout, move this cardio machine from room to room with the front-mounted transportation wheels.

Be in control of your workout entertainment when you place your personal device into the tablet holder. Feel confident during enduring workouts with the 265 lb weight capacity. fields.AU:
The pinnacle of Sunny Health & Fitness high performance biking experience is here in the Magnetic Indoor Cycle Exercise Bike - SF-B121021. Packed with features to enhance your performance and riding experience. You’ll never miss the cycling studio or gym ever again with this magnetic stationary home fitness bike.

fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Sunny Health & Fitness Essential Connected Magnetic Cycle Bike is a perfect product for anyone looking to get into indoor cycling for the first time. Ergonomically designed, this stationary indoor bike has rounded grip handlebars and adjustable seating that can help maintain your comfort and stability while riding at home. Connect to the bike with your mobile device via Bluetooth and access our SunnyFit® App’s cycling programs and guided workouts led by our certified trainers. Cycling on an indoor exercise bike is a low-impact exercise that can strengthen your cardiovascular performance and engage muscles in your arms, core, and legs. With a simple twist of a knob, adjust the magnetic resistance with load depending on how much effort you want to put in per indoor cycling session. What are you waiting for?
• SMART FITNESS: Cycle along with Sunny Health & Fitness expert trainers on the Sunny Health & Fitness SunnyFit® App. Connect your preferred mobile device through Bluetooth and view your performance metrics in real-time.
• 4-WAY ADJUSTABLE SEAT: Built for comfort, the seat is fully adjustable. Adjust the seat up-down or front-back, depending on your height and comfort. It integrates a consistent layer of support and has a longitudinal groove to promote a healthy blood flow.
• 2-WAY ADJUSTABLE HANDLEBARS: Handlebar is 2-way adjustable and will adjust to any rider's body and workout. It’s designed for multiple grips with a unified aero bar in the middle. It’s urethane-dipped, so it provides a secure and comfortable grip.
• EMERGENCY STOP BRAKE: Your workout can be brought to an immediate stop with this convenient emergency brake button. Any uncontrollable spinning will cease by pressing this button.
• BOTTLE HOLDER: The convenient bottle holder keeps your favorite refreshing beverage within arm's reach. Proper hydration will ensure your health and workout performance stay at optimum levels!
• CAGED PEDALS: These built-in toe cages on the pedals accommodate for any shoe size providing the ultimate stability for any workout duration. Avoid foot slippage at increased levels of speed and intensity.
• TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: Simply tilt and roll out for use or away for storage, no need for heavy lifting or muscle strain. The wheels at the front of the unit allow the user to move their equipment around with ease.

fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
The pinnacle of convenient, high-performance, home exercise bikes is here in the Sunny Health & Fitness Pro-Lite Indoor Cycling Exercise Bike. Utilizing a space-efficient design, the Pro-Lite maximizes your workout sessions while keeping the indoor exercise bike light and movable. The high inertia flywheel is designed and formulated using a proprietary alloy blend material and process that reduces carbon emissions compared with traditional flywheels. This is more than just a stationary bike, each one of the Pro-Lite features is devised to augment or amplify your at-home workouts, to push you further, and help you become better!
• DIGITAL MONITOR: Stay on top of your fitness by tracking your Time, Speed, Distance, Calories Burned, Odometer, RPM, and Pulse. you may also rotate through these metrics using the Scan feature.
• DEVICE HOLDER: Ride along with our Sunny Health & Fitness trainers or with the preferred indoor cycling app or program of your choice.
• SILENT: Belt-driven means that pedaling on the Pro-Lite is near silent and with fewer maintenance routines required compared with chain drivetrains. 
• CONTACTLESS RESISTANCE: Magnetic resistance avoids any direct contact between moving parts. The benefits include a much linear and exceptionally smoother operation as well as little to no maintenance required.
• HIGH INERTIA: Whether you're climbing or sprinting during your riding sessions, the 18 LB flywheel produces superior inertia to keep the momentum going further.
• RESISTANCE LEVELS: The 7 levels of magnetic resistance can easily and quickly be adjusted with the resistance lever. Each level of change will produce an audible click to keep you aware of your setting. 
• ADJUSTABLE: The 4-way adjustable seat paired with the 2-way height adjustable handlebar lets you ride on an exercise bike that fits your personal dimensions. 
• TRANSPORTATION WHEEL: Move your indoor cycle bike from room-to-room with the easy-to-use transportation wheels. The thick wheels can smoothly transport on a variety of surfaces, including carpet.
• PULSE-SENSING GRIPS: Monitor your cardiovascular performance with the built-in pulse-sensing grips so you can actively check your workout progress, displayed on the digital monitor.

Go fast, slow, forwards, backwards or any pace in between with the Sunny Health & Fitness Electric Motorized Under Desk Elliptical - SF-E3959. Convenient and space-efficient workouts come easy with this mini elliptical. Designed for no fuss and no hassle workouts, get your heart pumping and your legs active with just a press of the button - wirelessly!

fields.AU:
Attain the results your body deserves with the SF-E3804 Endurance Zone Magnetic Elliptical Trainer by Sunny Health and Fitness. This high interval elliptical trainer promotes a full-body workout that combines arm and leg weight-bearing forms of aerobic exercise. Step onto the large texture grip pedals while you grasp the sweat-resistant, high-density handlebars and activate muscle groups throughout your whole body. When utilizing the full-motion handlebars, the user will engage muscles in their pecs, biceps, traps, and pecs while simultaneously activating muscles in your glutes, thighs, and hamstrings. 8 levels of resistance on the elliptical machine create an excellent cardio workout without the high impact on knees and joints! Watch your fitness journey on the easy-to-read performance monitor displaying speed, time, RPM, distance, and calories. This fitness elliptical is designed with a 13.5-inch stride length making it an excellent for cardio training machine. Pedal forward or backward to engage and activate muscles in your glutes, hamstrings, and quads that aren't as activated during treadmill or cycling exercise. fields.AU:
The Sunny Health & Fitness Digital Jump Rope is designed using resilient, vinyl material for optimal speed. The anti-slip grip handles provide full motion control so you can focus on your workout. Convenient LCD screen keeps a precise record of your workout: clock keeps accurate time, timer lets you set you workout time, count-mechanism keeps track of your jumps, calorie counter keeps a precise record of you burned calories, and fat percentage mode tracks the amount of fat reduced. The Rotator Swivel Action Head keeps a precise record of your jumps and ensures optimal control for jumping forward, backward, and crisscross. Our Digital Jump Rope is a great product to simultaneously strengthen your upper and lower body for an effective and efficient exercise session.
• ADJUSTABLE: Extra-long 118 inches rope is easily customized for your height.

• NON-SLIP: Anti-slip, slightly textured handle design
• LCD FUNCTION Clock, Timer, Count, Calorie and Fat
• RESILIENT MATERIAL: Engineered and designed with tough and resilient vinyl material, it is optimal for durability and speed

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness No. 069 Speed Cable Jump Rope
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
The Sunny Health and Fitness 069 Speed Cable Jump Rope is designed to create an effective cardio routine to keep your heart pumping and your body moving. Jump roping is a calorie cooker! Jumping moderately burns about 16 calories a minute. Our speed rope will not only help you build agility and quickness but the durable design will keep you workout longer and more comfortable.
• ATHLETE APPROVED AND TESTED: Recently featured at the Legion of Beast CrossFit Games, this speed cable is meant for long-lasting workouts in the toughest conditions. Keep pushing without worrying about breaking or snapping this rope. The rope design helps increase the speed and smoothness of the rope turning. Using the fitness ropes is a great cross-training tool when training for sports like boxing, CrossFit, or muay Thai. Utilizing them can help improve speed, agility, and strength.
• Versatile tangle resistant 118 inch speed rope
• Adjustable screws provide a customizable rope length to suit users of various sizes
• DURABLE: The durable, high-density plastic handles provide maximum comfort during exercise to maintain a long-lasting cardio routine. This sturdy skipping rope features a braided, lightweight, vinyl-coated steel cable. Whether you're doing singles or double under, this exercise rope is going to maintain even the toughest of workouts.
• ADJUSTABLE & TANGLE RESISTANT: The versatile, tangle-resistant 118inch speed rope length is perfect for trainers and suitable for men and women of various sizes. The adjustable screws provide a customizable rope length to intensify the workout for any type of user. Now, multiple users can train with this fitness jump rope. The compact size for portability is great for outdoor training and fitness on the go.
• Ideal for conditioning and physical fitness uses
• Ideal for cardiovascular workouts and building cadence, coordination, balance, agility and overall physique

fields.AU:
This Sunny Health and Fitness Anti-Burst Fitness Ball is a wonderful choice for people who want to stay in shape and strengthen overall body muscles. Develop balance and coordination with this gym ball by using it to prop up your feet during push-ups or simply sit on it at home or at work to strengthen your core. This ball is suitable for people of all ages and fitness levels and is built to last.
• IMPROVE BALANCE AND FLEXIBILITY: Utilize the anti-burst ball to strengthen, tone, and build muscles throughout your body. Utilizing an Aerobic Ball is excellent for improving and developing flexibility and coordination.
• INFLATION PUMP INCLUDE: Convenient inflation pump is included so you can easily inflate your fitness ball. A slow deflating mechanism is designed for slow deflation if accidentally punctured.

• EXCELLENT FITNESS TOOL: Develop balance and coordination on the large anti-burst fitness aerobic ball. This yoga ball comes with instructions on stretches and functions you can perform at home.

Additionally, anti-slip pedals and floor stabilizers enhance safety, while built-in wheels make it easy to move and store.For added convenience, the elliptical includes a built-in bottle and device holder, allowing users to stay hydrated and entertained during workouts. It tracks essential workout metrics such as time, speed, distance, and heart rate on a digital monitor. • 【ULTIMATE COMFORT】Customizable foot pedals with an anti-slip design serves various body types for comfortable & effective workout. The ergonomic design & comfortable handle grip enhance your workout experience, providing stability and ease of use.

• MAGNETIC RESISTANCE: The 8 levels of magnetic resistance make working out easy when you want it, hard when you need it. Switch up the intensity to boost or lower your challenge based on your comfort level.
• BOTTLE HOLDER: Conveniently located at just an arm's length away from hydration. Stay cool and refreshed with your favorite mid-workout beverage.
• TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: Enjoy a portable cardiovascular machine that can roll from room to room in your home for easy storage.

fields.AU:
The Sunny Health & Fitness High-Density EPP Foam Roller is built for firm, controlled pressure—not soft cushioning. Its intentionally hard construction helps transfer body weight into focused pressure while resisting compression and maintaining dependable support through repeated rolling, stretching, and exercise. Choose from four lengths to match your routine: the compact 12" and 18" sizes are ideal for targeted muscle work and easier maneuverability, while the 24" provides versatile coverage and the 36" offers more surface area for the back, legs, and larger movements. Use it before or after activity for stretching, mobility work, warmups, cooldowns, and everyday recovery when muscles feel tired or tight. Lightweight yet durable EPP foam makes it easy to move, store, or bring to the gym. Every size is available in Black, Blue, or Pink. For even more workout variety, access trainer-led stretching, mobility, yoga, and fitness sessions through the free SunnyFit App.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Exercise Wheel
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Utilize the natural kinetic energy of your core movements with the Sunny Health & Fitness No.003 Exercise Wheel. Ergonomic design enhances a full range motion of your body. This Fitness Wheel acts as a personal fitness trainer – helping to sculpt your abdominal muscles while burning calories and improving overall endurance. Guide your body to help strengthen and tones your abs, arms, shoulders, and back. Non-slip grip, solid steel handlebars, and non-slip heavy-duty modeled disks ensure optimal comfort and full motion control. Harness your kinetic energy to trim and tone your oblique (abs), arms, shoulders, and back with the Sunny Health & Fitness Exercise Wheel.
• CORE TRAINING: Each repetition of the rollout exercise works various muscles targeting your abs, hip flexors, shoulders, and back. It will not only help improve your lower back strength but decreases your risk of muscular injury.
• DOUBLE-WHEEL DESIGN: Wide shaped wheel ensures stability and bears the weight of your entire body. The wheel’s textured surface promotes stability and control. Handles prevent slipping and while reducing hand fatigue.
• BEGINNER TO ADVANCED: Build your core progressively by starting from a kneeling position and performing rolling push-ups. Eventually, advance to more difficult positions. Perform push-ups or hold a push-up position for a variety in your workout.
• ERGONOMIC: This lightweight, compact abs wheel is weighted at 1.1 lbs. making this tool the perfect size for fitness on the go. Take it to work for a quick lunchtime workout and store it in a closet when not in use.
• GREAT FITNESS TOOL: The Abs Wheel could be the most versatile fitness tool in your home gym. you can move back and forth and side to side to engage your side abdominals and oblique muscles.
• FOAM GRIP: The foamed covered grip enhances comfort during your ab workouts to reduce blisters and calluses.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Adjustable Weighted Vest 11-20lbs
fields.N: 1 year structural frame, 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Add resistance to the movement you already do with the Sunny Health & Fitness Adjustable Weighted Vest. Choose from three progressive weight ranges—4–10 lb, 11–20 lb, or 20–32 lb—to match your fitness level, workout style, and resistance goals. Each vest starts with a built-in base weight and includes 6 removable inserts, allowing you to add or remove weight as your training progresses. The X-Balance design helps distribute weight evenly, while independent insert compartments help reduce shifting during walking, jogging, weighted walking, squats, lunges, step-ups, push-ups, and bodyweight workouts. Adjustable side webbing straps and quick-release buckles help create a secure fit, while reflective accents support low-light visibility and a front small-item zipper pocket keeps essentials within reach. Compact, wearable, and easy to use, this weighted vest helps make everyday workouts more challenging without holding dumbbells or using bulky equipment.
【PICK THE RIGHT TRAINING WEIGHT】Choose the adjustable weighted vest that fits your workout style. The 4–10 lb vest is best for lighter training, walking, lighter jogging, and users new to weighted vest training. The 11–20 lb vest supports moderate walking, jogging, bodyweight training, and home workout circuits. The 20–32 lb vest is best for heavier weighted walking, strength circuits, and more demanding bodyweight workouts.
【PROGRESS WITH REMOVABLE WEIGHTS】Each vest starts with a built-in base weight and includes 6 removable sand inserts so you can add resistance gradually. The 4–10 lb vest includes six 1 lb weights, the 11–20 lb vest includes six 1.5 lb weights, and the 20–32 lb vest includes six 2 lb weights.
【MOVE WITH BETTER BALANCE】The X-Balance design helps distribute weight across the vest for better movement control. Independent weight compartments help reduce shifting during walking, squats, lunges, and bodyweight circuits.
【STAYS SECURE WHILE YOU TRAIN】Adjustable side webbing straps and quick-release buckles help create a secure fit before you train. Excess strap loops help keep loose ends tucked away and reduce workout distractions.
【TRAIN OUTDOORS WITH ESSENTIALS】Reflective details help improve visibility during outdoor walking or low-light workouts, while the front small-item zipper pocket keeps keys, cards, or other essentials within reach.
【ADD RESISTANCE TO YOUR ROUTINE】Add wearable resistance to walking, jogging, weighted walking, squats, lunges, step-ups, push-ups, and bodyweight workouts without holding dumbbells or using bulky fitness equipment.
【EST. IN SUNNY CALIFORNIA SINCE 2002】Sunny Health & Fitness delivers premium equipment with a commitment to quality. Backed by U.S.-based support and certified trainers, we offer a truly unmatched “Fit for Everyone” experience.

fields.AU:
Build balance, core control, and full-body stability with the Sunny Health & Fitness NO. 120 Balance Board. Its 360° wobble and weight-shifting movement, with a maximum 24.5° tilt angle, adds challenge to standing balance, squats, lunges, twists, plank variations, push-ups, and seated core exercises.
The raised bump-textured surface supports foot placement while adding a massage-like feel and foot stimulation. A bottom TPE anti-slip layer and anti-slip protrusions help support grip during indoor use, while built-in handles make the board easy to carry, store, and use for hand-supported exercises. With a 16.34-inch platform, 12-screw reinforced structure, lightweight design, and 300 lb max weight recommendation, this compact wobble board brings balance, core, lower-body, and full-body stability training into everyday home fitness routines.
【360° BALANCE & STABILITY TRAINING】Add challenge to everyday movement with a 360° wobble balance board designed to support balance, coordination, core engagement, ankle stability, calf strength, and full-body control during home fitness routines.
【BEGINNER TO ADVANCED EXERCISE VARIETY】Use this compact balance trainer for standing balance during workouts or at a standing desk, plus low-impact stability practice, squats, reverse lunges, one-leg squats, waist twists, boat holds, Russian twists, mountain climbers, push-ups, and plank variations.
【24.5° TILT FOR CONTROLLED CHALLENGE】The rounded underside supports 360° weight shifting with a maximum 24.5° tilt angle, helping users start with basic balance practice and progress into squats, twists, lunges, planks, and seated core exercises.
【TEXTURED SURFACE FOR ADDED GRIP】The raised bump-textured surface helps support foot placement during balance training while adding a massage-like feel and foot stimulation, whether used barefoot or with shoes during controlled workouts.
【BOTTOM TPE ANTI-SLIP LAYER】Anti-slip protrusions and a bottom TPE layer help support grip during use on indoor surfaces. Use with a yoga or exercise mat for added floor protection, especially on delicate flooring.
【BUILT-IN HANDLES FOR FULL-BODY TRAINING】Integrated side handles make the board easy to carry, move, and store, while also supporting hand-based exercises such as planks and push-ups for added upper-body, shoulder, core, and stabilizer engagement.
【16.34" PLATFORM WITH 300 LB SUPPORT】The 16.34-inch round platform gives users room for two-foot balance work, while the 12-screw reinforced structure and 300 lb max weight recommendation support controlled stability training.
【COMPACT HOME FITNESS ACCESSORY】Lightweight, portable, and easy to store, this wobble board brings balance, core, lower-body, and full-body stability training into small indoor workout spaces, home gyms, yoga areas, and daily movement routines.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness SMART Compact Full Motion Rowing Machine - Pink
fields.AU:
Make every workout count by connecting this rower to your smart devices via Bluetooth. Sync with the SunnyFit App to access over 1000 workouts and 10,000 scenic global rowing routes right on the machine's display. Personalize each workout and track your real-time progress as you row. This full-body workout activates your legs, back, core, and arms for a comprehensive exercise regime. 
Built with a 400LB weight capacity, this rowing machine robustly accommodates users of all sizes to kickstart their fitness journey with hassle-free setup. Feel like you're rowing on water with this machine's realistic rowing simulation through the SunnyFit App for a more engaging and effective home workout. The Digital Monitor tracks stroke rate, time, count, calories, and total strokes to simplify monitoring your rowing workout.
Customize your workout intensity with 12 levels of smooth, adjustable resistance. Easily increase or decrease the resistance for a workout that challenges you while gently impacting your joints. The ergonomic padded seat with elevated, wider design allows for easy mounting, superior comfort, and no slipping during prolonged workouts. Non-slip grip handlebars add stability.
Assemble this rowing machine easily and start working out on the large anti-slip foot pedals with adjustable straps that keep your feet secure while rowing. For over 20 years, Sunny Health & Fitness has been a top fitness brand dedicated to offering superior products, excellent customer service, and an unbeatable fitness experience.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Multi-Function Squat Assist Trainer
fields.AU:
Build strength, improve movement control, and train your lower body from the comfort of home with the Sunny Health & Fitness Multi-Function Squat Assist Trainer. Designed for adults seeking a more supported alternative to traditional bodyweight squats, this compact trainer helps guide squat-style movements with adjustable resistance assistance and customizable support points.
Unlike standard squat benches or unsupported exercises, this trainer combines a 3-band resistance and return assistance system, adjustable seat support, shin/calf cushions, and ankle positioning support to create a more controlled workout experience. Users can customize their setup for improved comfort, stability, and movement control while targeting quads, glutes, legs, and core.
Designed for small-space home gyms, apartments, garages, or bedrooms, the Sunny Squat Assist Trainer provides multiple workout options in one compact machine, including supported squats, lower-body strengthening, sit-ups, core training, and deep-stretch push-up variations.
【MULTI-FUNCTION SQUAT ASSIST TRAINER】Designed for adults who want more support and control than unsupported squats, this compact home trainer combines adjustable body positioning with band-assisted movement for lower-body, core, and push-up training.
【TARGET LEGS, QUADS & GLUTES】Supported squat-style movements provide a focused way to train the quads, glutes, and lower body while developing controlled movement in a guided home workout format.
【4-POSITION ADJUSTABLE SEAT】Choose from four seat-support positions to better match your body and movement setup, helping improve comfort, positioning, and control during supported squat-style exercises.
【4-LEVEL SHIN/CALF SUPPORT】Adjustable padded shin and calf cushions provide four positioning levels to help stabilize the lower legs and create a more customized fit throughout your workout.

fields.AU:
Looking to save space while still getting in your cardio workout? The Pacer Smart Compact Auto Incline Treadpad® Treadmill, is a reliable and practical alternative to your traditional treadmill. The easy-to-assemble frame setup is perfect for your home. Counting calories, steps, and miles, is easy with the SunnyFit® App which easily connects to the treadmill via Bluetooth.
【CONNECTED FITNESS】Via Bluetooth connectivity, this compact treadmill connects to the SunnyFit® App, granting access to an array of free workouts and fitness programs. Track your progress, set fitness goals, access personalized workout plans, and compete with other community members to get to the top of the leaderboard. Have all the workouts of your choice right at your fingertips, while also feeling supported as a member of this like-minded SunnyFit® App community.
【UNDER DESK DESIGN】 Get your steps in while you work from home at your desk. This low profile, space-saving design allows you to store your treadmill out of the way, and easily underneath furniture, when not in use. Note: Handlebars Foldable.
【6-LEVEL AUTOMATIC INCLINE】 This hybrid walking treadmill boasts 6 preset incline options that automatically adjust with just the touch of a button. Easily customize each workout so you always take on the perfect level of challenge.
【DUAL MODE (WALK + RUN)】 With two modes (walk or run), this treadmill can be used without handles as a walking treadmill, with a speed range of 0.5 to 3.7 mph. With the handlebar unfolded and fully extended, the treadmill allows for running speeds of up to 6 mph.
【QUICK ASSEMBLY】This indoor treadmill arrives intact with minimal assembly. Simply unbox, unfold the treadmill deck from the console, and begin your workout. Convenient pre-assembly means you can save time, money, and energy when putting together this treadmill.
【TRACK YOUR PROGRESS】The large backlit LED display shows Calories, Distance, Speed, Steps, and Time. Easily keep track of your fitness progress at any moment during your workout.
【REMOTE CONTROL】Adjust your settings while you work out seamlessly. With all the controls in the palm of your hand, we make it easy for you to operate the machine without compromising your precious workout time.
【TRANSPORTATION WHEELS】 Built-in transportation wheels for easy portability. Simply tilt and roll out for use or away for storage, no need to lift.
【SMART REMINDER】This compact indoor treadmill is programmed to remind you when your treadmill needs more lubrication. Extend the lifespan of your treadmill, once the machine reaches 188 miles, an alarm will notify you to lubricate the running belt (lubricant oil comes included).
【FLOOR STABILIZERS】 Simply twist until level to maintain a stable and solid base as you row. This is essential for your safety, balance, and ease of mind.
